// ============================================================
// TOKEN STORE
// ============================================================

export class TokenStore {
  private tokens: Map<string, AuthToken> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 100) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  set(key: string, token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.tokens.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = this.tokens.keys().next().value;
      if (oldest) this.tokens.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.tokens.set(key, token);
  }

  get(key: string): AuthToken | undefined {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return undefined;
    if (token.expiresAt <= new Date()) {
      this.tokens.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    return token;
  }

  isExpired(key: string): boolean {
    const token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) return true;
    return token.expiresAt <= new Date(Date.now() + 60000);
  }

  clear(key?: string): void {
    if (key) this.tokens.delete(key);
    else this.tokens.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// HMAC SIGNER
// ============================================================

export class HMACSigner {
  private readonly secret: string;
  private readonly algorithm: string;

  constructor(secret: string, algorithm: string = 'sha256') {
    this.secret = secret;
    this.algorithm = algorithm;
  }

  sign(method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): string {
    const payload = [method.toUpperCase(), path, body, timestamp, nonce].join('\n');
    return crypto
      .createHmac(this.algorithm, this.secret)
      .update(payload)
      .digest('hex');
  }

  verify(signature: string, method: string, path: string, body: string, timestamp: string, nonce: string): boolean {
    const expected = this.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
    try {
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  generateNonce(): string {
    return crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// SOVEREIGN KEY MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class SovereignKeyManager {
  private readonly key: string;
  private readonly tenantId: string;

  constructor(key: string, tenantId: string) {
    this.key = key;
    this.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  generateToken(expiryMs: number = 3600000): AuthToken {
    const now = new Date();
    const payload = {
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      issuedAt: now.toISOString(),
      nonce: crypto.randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
    };
    const signature = crypto
      .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
      .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
      .digest('hex');

    const accessToken = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ ...payload, signature })).toString('base64');

    return {
      accessToken,
      tokenType: 'Sovereign',
      expiresAt: new Date(now.getTime() + expiryMs),
      tenantId: this.tenantId,
      scope: ['*'],
    };
  }

  verify(token: string): boolean {
    try {
      const decoded = JSON.parse(Buffer.from(token, 'base64').toString('utf8'));
      const { signature, ...payload } = decoded;
      const expected = crypto
        .createHmac('sha512', this.key)
        .update(JSON.stringify(payload))
        .digest('hex');
      return crypto.timingSafeEqual(
        Buffer.from(signature, 'hex'),
        Buffer.from(expected, 'hex')
      );
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// OAUTH2 CLIENT
// ============================================================

export class OAuth2Client {
  private readonly config: OAuth2Config;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private readonly cacheKey: string;

  constructor(config: OAuth2Config) {
    this.config = config;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.cacheKey = `oauth2:${config.clientId}`;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(this.cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(this.cacheKey)) return cached;
    return this.fetchToken();
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: this.config.grantType || 'client_credentials',
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
      scope: (this.config.scope || ['*']).join(' '),
    });

    try {
      const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
        body: body.toString(),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new UBEAuthError(`OAuth2 token fetch failed: ${res.status} ${res.statusText}`);
      }

      const data = await res.json() as {
        access_token: string;
        token_type: string;
        expires_in?: number;
        refresh_token?: string;
        scope?: string;
      };

      const token: AuthToken = {
        accessToken: data.access_token,
        tokenType: 'Bearer',
        expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
        refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
        scope: data.scope?.split(' '),
      };

      this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
      return token;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`OAuth2 request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  async refreshToken(refreshToken: string): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const body = new URLSearchParams({
      grant_type: 'refresh_token',
      refresh_token: refreshToken,
      client_id: this.config.clientId,
      client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
    });

    const res = await fetch(this.config.tokenEndpoint, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
      body: body.toString(),
    });

    if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError('Token refresh failed');
    const data = await res.json() as { access_token: string; expires_in?: number; refresh_token?: string };

    const token: AuthToken = {
      accessToken: data.access_token,
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + (data.expires_in || 3600) * 1000),
      refreshToken: data.refresh_token || refreshToken,
    };

    this.tokenStore.set(this.cacheKey, token);
    return token;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// API KEY VALIDATOR
// ============================================================

export class APIKeyValidator {
  private readonly cache: Map<string, APIKeyInfo> = new Map();
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(endpoint: string) {
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
  }

  async validate(apiKey: string): Promise<APIKeyInfo> {
    const cacheKey = this.hash(apiKey);
    const cached = this.cache.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && new Date() < (cached.expiresAt || new Date('9999-12-31'))) {
      return cached;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/validate`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'X-API-Key': apiKey,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ apiKey }),
      });

      if (res.status === 401) throw new UBEAuthError('Invalid API key', UBEErrorCode.AUTH_INVALID_KEY);
      if (!res.ok) throw new UBEAuthError(`API key validation failed: ${res.status}`);

      const info = await res.json() as APIKeyInfo;
      this.cache.set(cacheKey, info);
      return info;
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof UBEAuthError) throw err;
      throw new UBENetworkError(`Validation request failed: ${String(err)}`);
    }
  }

  private hash(key: string): string {
    return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(key).digest('hex').substring(0, 16);
  }

  clearCache(): void {
    this.cache.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN AUTH MANAGER
// ============================================================

export class AuthManager {
  private state: AuthState;
  private readonly tokenStore: TokenStore;
  private hmacSigner?: HMACSigner;
  private oauth2Client?: OAuth2Client;
  private sovereignKeyManager?: SovereignKeyManager;
  private refreshTimer?: NodeJS.Timeout;
  private readonly config: UBEConfig;
  private readonly endpoint: string;

  constructor(config: UBEConfig, endpoint: string) {
    this.config = config;
    this.endpoint = endpoint;
    this.tokenStore = new TokenStore();
    this.state = {
      method: config.authMethod || (config.apiKey ? AuthMethod.API_KEY : AuthMethod.JWT),
      apiKey: config.apiKey,
      tenantId: config.tenantId,
      refreshCount: 0,
    };

    this.initializeMethod();
  }

  private initializeMethod(): void {
    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.HMAC:
        if (this.config.apiKey) {
          this.hmacSigner = new HMACSigner(this.config.apiKey);
        }
        break;
      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY:
        if (this.config.sovereignKey && this.config.tenantId) {
          this.sovereignKeyManager = new SovereignKeyManager(
            this.config.sovereignKey,
            this.config.tenantId
          );
        }
        break;
    }
  }

  async getHeaders(method: string = 'GET', path: string = '/', body: string = ''): Promise<AuthHeaders> {
    const headers: AuthHeaders = {};

    if (this.config.tenantId) {
      headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
    }

    switch (this.state.method) {
      case AuthMethod.API_KEY:
        if (!this.state.apiKey) throw new UBEAuthError('API key not configured');
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        break;

      case AuthMethod.JWT: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.OAUTH2: {
        const token = await this.getValidToken();
        headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token.accessToken}`;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.HMAC: {
        if (!this.hmacSigner || !this.state.apiKey) {
          throw new UBEAuthError('HMAC signer not initialized');
        }
        const timestamp = Date.now().toString();
        const nonce = this.hmacSigner.generateNonce();
        const signature = this.hmacSigner.sign(method, path, body, timestamp, nonce);
        headers['X-API-Key'] = this.state.apiKey;
        headers['X-HMAC-Signature'] = signature;
        headers['X-HMAC-Timestamp'] = timestamp;
        headers['X-HMAC-Nonce'] = nonce;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.SOVEREIGN_KEY: {
        if (!this.sovereignKeyManager) throw new UBEAuthError('Sovereign key not configured');
        const token = this.sovereignKeyManager.generateToken();
        headers['X-Sovereign-Key'] = token.accessToken;
        if (this.config.tenantId) headers['X-Tenant-ID'] = this.config.tenantId;
        break;
      }

      case AuthMethod.MTLS:
        break;
    }

    return headers;
  }

  private async getValidToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    const cacheKey = `token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`;
    const cached = this.tokenStore.get(cacheKey);
    if (cached && !this.tokenStore.isExpired(cacheKey)) return cached;

    const fresh = await this.fetchToken();
    this.tokenStore.set(cacheKey, fresh);
    this.state.token = fresh;
    this.state.lastRefresh = new Date();
    this.state.refreshCount++;
    this.scheduleRefresh(fresh);
    return fresh;
  }

  private async fetchToken(): Promise<AuthToken> {
    if (this.oauth2Client) return this.oauth2Client.getToken();
    if (this.state.apiKey) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${this.endpoint}/auth/token`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
            'X-API-Key': this.state.apiKey,
          },
        });
        if (res.ok) {
          const data = await res.json() as { accessToken: string; expiresAt: string };
          return {
            accessToken: data.accessToken,
            tokenType: 'Bearer',
            expiresAt: new Date(data.expiresAt),
          };
        }
      } catch {
        // Fall through to API key auth
      }
    }
    return {
      accessToken: this.state.apiKey || '',
      tokenType: 'Bearer',
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + 3600000),
    };
  }

  private scheduleRefresh(token: AuthToken): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    const refreshIn = token.expiresAt.getTime() - Date.now() - 300000;
    if (refreshIn > 0) {
      this.refreshTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        this.tokenStore.clear(`token:${this.state.tenantId || 'default'}`);
      }, refreshIn);
    }
  }

  isAuthenticated(): boolean {
    return !!(this.state.apiKey || this.state.token?.accessToken);
  }

  getState(): AuthState {
    return { ...this.state };
  }

  setTenantId(tenantId: string): void {
    this.state.tenantId = tenantId;
  }

  clearTokens(): void {
    this.tokenStore.clear();
    this.state.token = undefined;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    if (this.refreshTimer) clearTimeout(this.refreshTimer);
    this.clearTokens();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// AUTOMATION BUILDER IMPLEMENTATION
// ============================================================

class AutomationBuilderImpl implements AutomationBuilder {
  private request: AutomationRequest = { steps: [] };

  name(name: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.name = name;
    return this;
  }

  description(desc: string): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.description = desc;
    return this;
  }

  step(step: AutomationStep): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.steps.push(step);
    return this;
  }

  httpStep(name: string, url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONNECTOR' as any,
      connector: 'http',
      action: method.toLowerCase(),
      input: { url, method, body },
    });
  }

  transformStep(name: string, transform: TransformConfig): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'TRANSFORM' as any,
      action: 'transform',
      input: { transform },
    });
  }

  conditionStep(name: string, expression: string, onTrue?: string, onFalse?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'CONDITION' as any,
      action: 'evaluate',
      conditions: [{ expression, onTrue: onTrue || 'continue', onFalse }],
    });
  }

  encryptStep(name: string, keyId?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'ENCRYPT' as any,
      action: 'encrypt',
      input: { keyId },
      encrypt: true,
    });
  }

  storeStep(name: string, key: string, value?: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'STORE' as any,
      action: 'store',
      input: { key, value },
    });
  }

  notifyStep(name: string, channel: string, message: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.step({
      name,
      type: 'NOTIFY' as any,
      action: 'send',
      input: { channel, message },
    });
  }

  trigger(trigger: AutomationTrigger): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.trigger = trigger;
    return this;
  }

  onSchedule(cron: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.SCHEDULE, schedule: cron });
  }

  onWebhook(url: string): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.trigger({ type: WorkflowTriggerType.WEBHOOK, webhookUrl: url });
  }

  withOptions(options: AutomationOptions): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.options = { ...this.request.options, ...options };
    return this;
  }

  withEncryption(mode: EncryptionMode): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ encryptionMode: mode });
  }

  withRetry(policy: SDKRetryPolicy): AutomationBuilder {
    return this.withOptions({ retryPolicy: policy } as any);
  }

  withTag(...tags: string[]): AutomationBuilder {
    this.request.tags = [...(this.request.tags || []), ...tags];
    return this;
  }

  build(): AutomationRequest {
    if (!this.request.steps.length) {
      throw new UBEValidationError('Automation must have at least one step', [
        { field: 'steps', message: 'At least one step is required' },
      ]);
    }
    return { ...this.request };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// AUTOMATION SDK CLASS
// ============================================================

export class AutomationSDK {
  private readonly http: UBEHttpClient;

  constructor(http: UBEHttpClient) {
    this.http = http;
  }

  // ── Run ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async run(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>('/automations/run', request, options);
    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
      throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Automation run failed');
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  async runAndWait(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const result = await this.run(request, options);
    if (result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED || result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED) {
      return result;
    }
    return this.waitForCompletion(result.id, pollIntervalMs, timeoutMs, options);
  }

  async runBatch(
    batch: BatchRequest<AutomationRequest>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<BatchResult<AutomationResult>> {
    const res = await this.http.post<BatchResult<AutomationResult>>(
      '/automations/batch',
      batch,
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Batch run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Status & Polling ─────────────────────────────────────

  async get(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationResult>(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Automation ${automationId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async waitForCompletion(
    automationId: string,
    pollIntervalMs: number = 1000,
    timeoutMs: number = 300000,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const result = await this.get(automationId, options);
      if (
        result.status === AutomationStatus.COMPLETED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.FAILED ||
        result.status === AutomationStatus.CANCELLED
      ) {
        return result;
      }
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, pollIntervalMs));
    }
    throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_TIMEOUT, `Automation ${automationId} timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
  }

  async list(filter?: AutomationFilter, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (filter?.status) params.set('status', filter.status.join(','));
    if (filter?.tags) params.set('tags', filter.tags.join(','));
    if (filter?.page) params.set('page', filter.page.toString());
    if (filter?.pageSize) params.set('pageSize', filter.pageSize.toString());
    if (filter?.sortBy) params.set('sortBy', filter.sortBy);
    if (filter?.sortOrder) params.set('sortOrder', filter.sortOrder);

    const res = await this.http.get<PaginatedResponse<AutomationListItem>>(
      `/automations?${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data || { items: [], total: 0, page: 1, pageSize: 20, hasMore: false };
  }

  // ── Control ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async cancel(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/cancel`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pause(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async resume(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/${automationId}/resume`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async retry(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/${automationId}/retry`,
      {},
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Retry failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async delete(automationId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/${automationId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Scheduling ────────────────────────────────────────────

  async schedule(
    request: AutomationRequest,
    cron: string,
    timezone: string = 'UTC',
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<ScheduledAutomation> {
    const res = await this.http.post<ScheduledAutomation>(
      '/automations/schedule',
      { request, schedule: cron, timezone },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Schedule failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  async listScheduled(options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<ScheduledAutomation[]> {
    const res = await this.http.get<{ schedules: ScheduledAutomation[] }>('/automations/schedules', options);
    return res.data?.schedules || [];
  }

  async cancelSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.delete(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}`, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  async pauseSchedule(scheduleId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<boolean> {
    const res = await this.http.post(`/automations/schedules/${scheduleId}/pause`, {}, options);
    return res.success;
  }

  // ── Templates ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listTemplates(category?: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate[]> {
    const params = category ? `?category=${category}` : '';
    const res = await this.http.get<{ templates: AutomationTemplate[] }>(
      `/automations/templates${params}`,
      options
    );
    return res.data?.templates || [];
  }

  async getTemplate(templateId: string, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<AutomationTemplate> {
    const res = await this.http.get<AutomationTemplate>(`/automations/templates/${templateId}`, options);
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.API_NOT_FOUND, `Template ${templateId} not found`);
    return res.data;
  }

  async runTemplate(
    templateId: string,
    variables: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationResult>(
      `/automations/templates/${templateId}/run`,
      { variables },
      options
    );
    if (!res.data) throw new UBEError(UBEErrorCode.AUTOMATION_FAILED, 'Template run failed');
    return res.data;
  }

  // ── Metrics ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async getMetrics(
    period: { start: Date; end: Date },
    options?: UBERequestOptions
  ): Promise<AutomationMetrics> {
    const res = await this.http.post<AutomationMetrics>('/automations/metrics', { period }, options);
    return res.data || {
      total: 0, byStatus: {} as any, averageDurationMs: 0,
      successRate: 0, totalDataProcessed: 0, topConnectors: [],
      period,
    };
  }

  // ── Dry Run ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  async dryRun(request: AutomationRequest, options?: UBERequestOptions): Promise<{
    valid: boolean;
    estimatedDurationMs: number;
    stepCount: number;
    warnings: string[];
    errors: string[];
  }> {
    const res = await this.http.post(
      '/automations/dry-run',
      { ...request, options: { ...request.options, dryRun: true } },
      options
    );
    return res.data as any || { valid: false, estimatedDurationMs: 0, stepCount: 0, warnings: [], errors: ['Dry run failed'] };
  }

  // ── Builder ───────────────────────────────────────────────

  builder(): AutomationBuilder {
    return new AutomationBuilderImpl();
  }

  // ── Quick shortcuts ───────────────────────────────────────

  async runHTTP(url: string, method: string = 'GET', body?: unknown): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name(`HTTP ${method} ${url}`)
        .httpStep('request', url, method, body)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runTransform(data: unknown, transform: TransformConfig): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Transform')
        .step({ name: 'input', type: 'STORE' as any, action: 'store', input: { key: 'data', value: data } })
        .transformStep('transform', transform)
        .build()
    );
  }

  async runChain(steps: AutomationStep[], options?: AutomationOptions): Promise<AutomationResult> {
    return this.run(
      this.builder()
        .name('Chain')
        .withOptions(options || {})
        .build()
    );
  }
}

export { AutomationBuilderImpl };
/**
 * UBE SDK — sdk/src/base-module.ts
 * Abstract base class all community modules must extend.
 * Provides: validation, throttling, auth, lifecycle, metrics, health.
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

export type ModuleStatus    = 'uninitialized'|'initializing'|'ready'|'degraded'|'stopping'|'stopped'|'error';
export type ModuleCategory  = 'connector'|'processor'|'analyzer'|'exporter'|'transformer'|'gateway'|'security'|'compliance';
export type LogLevel        = 'debug'|'info'|'warn'|'error'|'fatal';
export type HealthStatus    = 'healthy'|'degraded'|'unhealthy';

export interface ModuleManifest {
  id:           string;
  name:         string;
  version:      string;
  description:  string;
  author:       string;
  category:     ModuleCategory;
  tags:         string[];
  dependencies: ModuleDependency[];
  config:       ConfigSchema[];
  actions:      ActionSchema[];
  events:       EventSchema[];
  permissions:  string[];
  minSDKVersion: string;
}

export interface ModuleDependency {
  moduleId: string;
  version:  string;
  optional: boolean;
}

export interface ConfigSchema {
  key:          string;
  type:         'string'|'number'|'boolean'|'object'|'array'|'secret';
  required:     boolean;
  default?:     unknown;
  description:  string;
  validation?:  ValidationRule;
}

export interface ActionSchema {
  name:        string;
  description: string;
  input:       FieldSchema[];
  output:      FieldSchema[];
  rateLimit?:  RateLimitConfig;
}

export interface EventSchema {
  name:        string;
  description: string;
  payload:     FieldSchema[];
}

export interface FieldSchema {
  name:     string;
  type:     string;
  required: boolean;
  description: string;
}

export interface ValidationRule {
  min?:     number;
  max?:     number;
  pattern?: string;
  enum?:    unknown[];
  custom?:  (v: unknown) => boolean;
}

export interface RateLimitConfig {
  requests:  number;
  windowMs:  number;
  strategy:  'token_bucket'|'sliding_window'|'fixed_window';
}

export interface ModuleConfig {
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export interface ModuleContext {
  tenantId:    string;
  userId?:     string;
  requestId:   string;
  traceId:     string;
  permissions: string[];
  metadata:    Record<string, unknown>;
  timestamp:   number;
}

export interface ActionInput {
  action:  string;
  payload: Record<string, unknown>;
  context: ModuleContext;
  options: ActionOptions;
}

export interface ActionOptions {
  timeout?:   number;
  dryRun?:    boolean;
  traceMode?: boolean;
}

export interface ActionResult<T = unknown> {
  success:   boolean;
  data?:     T;
  error?:    ModuleError;
  metadata:  ResultMetadata;
}

export interface ResultMetadata {
  duration:     number;
  attempt:      number;
  cached:       boolean;
  rateThrottled: boolean;
  requestId:    string;
  timestamp:    number;
}

export interface ModuleError {
  code:     string;
  message:  string;
  details?: unknown;
  retryable: boolean;
}

export interface ModuleHealth {
  status:      HealthStatus;
  checks:      HealthCheck[];
  uptime:      number;
  lastCheck:   number;
  version:     string;
  metrics:     ModuleMetrics;
}

export interface HealthCheck {
  name:    string;
  status:  HealthStatus;
  message: string;
  latency: number;
}

export interface ModuleMetrics {
  totalRequests:  number;
  successCount:   number;
  errorCount:     number;
  avgLatencyMs:   number;
  p95LatencyMs:   number;
  p99LatencyMs:   number;
  throughputRps:  number;
  errorRate:      number;
  lastUpdated:    number;
}

export interface ModuleEvent {
  moduleId:   string;
  name:       string;
  payload:    unknown;
  tenantId:   string;
  timestamp:  number;
  traceId:    string;
}

// ─── Validation Engine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class SchemaValidator {
  static validateConfig(config: ModuleConfig, schema: ConfigSchema[]): string[] {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    for (const field of schema) {
      const val = config[field.key];
      if (field.required && (val === undefined || val === null)) {
        errors.push(`Required config key "${field.key}" is missing`);
        continue;
      }
      if (val === undefined) continue;
      // Type check
      const actualType = Array.isArray(val) ? 'array' : typeof val;
      if (field.type !== 'secret' && field.type !== actualType)
        errors.push(`Config key "${field.key}": expected ${field.type}, got ${actualType}`);
      // Validation rules
      if (field.validation) {
        const v = field.validation;
        if (v.min !== undefined && typeof val === 'number' && val < v.min)
          errors.push(`"${field.key}" must be >= ${v.min}`);
        if (v.max !== undefined && typeof val === 'number' && val > v.max)
          errors.push(`"${field.key}" must be <= ${v.max}`);
        if (v.pattern && typeof val === 'string' && !new RegExp(v.pattern).test(val))
          errors.push(`"${field.key}" does not match pattern ${v.pattern}`);
        if (v.enum && !v.enum.includes(val))
          errors.push(`"${field.key}" must be one of: ${v.enum.join(', ')}`);
        if (v.custom && !v.custom(val))
          errors.push(`"${field.key}" failed custom validation`);
      }
    }
    return errors;
  }

  static validateAction(input: Record<string, unknown>, schema: FieldSchema[]): string[] {
    const errors: string[] = [];
    for (const field of schema) {
      if (field.required && !(field.name in input))
        errors.push(`Required field "${field.name}" missing`);
    }
    return errors;
  }
}

// ─── Throttle Guard ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ThrottleGuard {
  private buckets: Map<string, { tokens: number; lastRefill: number }> = new Map();
  private windows: Map<string, { count: number; windowStart: number }> = new Map();

  check(key: string, config: RateLimitConfig): boolean {
    if (config.strategy === 'token_bucket') return this.tokenBucket(key, config);
    if (config.strategy === 'sliding_window') return this.slidingWindow(key, config);
    return this.fixedWindow(key, config);
  }

  private tokenBucket(key: string, cfg: RateLimitConfig): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (!this.buckets.has(key)) this.buckets.set(key, { tokens: cfg.requests, lastRefill: now });
    const bucket = this.buckets.get(key)!;
    const elapsed = now - bucket.lastRefill;
    const refill = (elapsed / cfg.windowMs) * cfg.requests;
    bucket.tokens = Math.min(cfg.requests, bucket.tokens + refill);
    bucket.lastRefill = now;
    if (bucket.tokens >= 1) { bucket.tokens--; return true; }
    return false;
  }

  private slidingWindow(key: string, cfg: RateLimitConfig): boolean {
    const now = Date.now();
    if (!this.windows.has(key)) this.windows.set(key, { count: 0, windowStart: now });
    const w = this.windows.get(key)!;
    if (now - w.windowStart > cfg.windowMs) { w.count = 0; w.windowStart = now; }
    if (w.count < cfg.requests) { w.count++; return true; }
    return false;
  }

  private fixedWindow(key: string, cfg: RateLimitConfig): boolean {
    return this.slidingWindow(key, cfg);
  }

  reset(key: string): void {
    this.buckets.delete(key);
    this.windows.delete(key);
  }
}

// ─── Metrics Collector ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MetricsCollector {
  private latencies: number[] = [];
  private metrics: ModuleMetrics = {
    totalRequests: 0, successCount: 0, errorCount: 0,
    avgLatencyMs: 0, p95LatencyMs: 0, p99LatencyMs: 0,
    throughputRps: 0, errorRate: 0, lastUpdated: Date.now(),
  };
  private windowStart = Date.now();

  record(success: boolean, latencyMs: number): void {
    this.metrics.totalRequests++;
    if (success) this.metrics.successCount++;
    else this.metrics.errorCount++;
    this.latencies.push(latencyMs);
    if (this.latencies.length > 1000) this.latencies.shift();
    this.recompute();
  }

  private recompute(): void {
    const sorted = [...this.latencies].sort((a,b) => a-b);
    const n = sorted.length;
    this.metrics.avgLatencyMs = n ? sorted.reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0) / n : 0;
    this.metrics.p95LatencyMs = n ? sorted[Math.floor(n * 0.95)] ?? 0 : 0;
    this.metrics.p99LatencyMs = n ? sorted[Math.floor(n * 0.99)] ?? 0 : 0;
    const elapsed = (Date.now() - this.windowStart) / 1000;
    this.metrics.throughputRps = elapsed > 0 ? this.metrics.totalRequests / elapsed : 0;
    this.metrics.errorRate = this.metrics.totalRequests > 0
      ? this.metrics.errorCount / this.metrics.totalRequests : 0;
    this.metrics.lastUpdated = Date.now();
  }

  get(): ModuleMetrics { return { ...this.metrics }; }
  reset(): void {
    this.latencies = [];
    this.metrics = { totalRequests:0, successCount:0, errorCount:0, avgLatencyMs:0, p95LatencyMs:0, p99LatencyMs:0, throughputRps:0, errorRate:0, lastUpdated:Date.now() };
    this.windowStart = Date.now();
  }
}

// ─── Module Logger ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ModuleLogger {
  private entries: { level: LogLevel; message: string; timestamp: number; data?: unknown }[] = [];
  constructor(private readonly moduleId: string) {}

  log(level: LogLevel, message: string, data?: unknown): void {
    const entry = { level, message, timestamp: Date.now(), data };
    this.entries.push(entry);
    if (this.entries.length > 500) this.entries.shift();
    if (typeof console !== 'undefined') {
      const method = level === 'error' || level === 'fatal' ? 'error' : level === 'warn' ? 'warn' : 'log';
      console[method](`[UBE:${this.moduleId}] [${level.toUpperCase()}] ${message}`, data ?? '');
    }
  }

  debug(msg: string, data?: unknown): void { this.log('debug', msg, data); }
  info(msg: string,  data?: unknown): void { this.log('info',  msg, data); }
  warn(msg: string,  data?: unknown): void { this.log('warn',  msg, data); }
  error(msg: string, data?: unknown): void { this.log('error', msg, data); }
  fatal(msg: string, data?: unknown): void { this.log('fatal', msg, data); }

  getLogs(level?: LogLevel, limit = 100) {
    return (level ? this.entries.filter(e => e.level === level) : this.entries).slice(-limit);
  }
}

// ─── Abstract Base Module ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export abstract class BaseModule {
  protected status:   ModuleStatus = 'uninitialized';
  protected config:   ModuleConfig = {};
  protected logger:   ModuleLogger;
  protected metrics:  MetricsCollector;
  protected throttle: ThrottleGuard;
  protected events:   ModuleEvent[] = [];
  private   startedAt: number = 0;
  private   eventListeners: Map<string, ((event: ModuleEvent) => void)[]> = new Map();

  /** Module metadata — must be implemented */
  abstract readonly manifest: ModuleManifest;

  constructor() {
    this.logger   = new ModuleLogger(this.constructor.name);
    this.metrics  = new MetricsCollector();
    this.throttle = new ThrottleGuard();
  }

  /** Lifecycle: called once on module load */
  protected abstract onInit(config: ModuleConfig): Promise<void>;

  /** Lifecycle: called on graceful shutdown */
  protected abstract onStop(): Promise<void>;

  /** Execute an action */
  protected abstract handle(input: ActionInput): Promise<ActionResult>;

  /** Health check implementation */
  protected abstract performHealthChecks(): Promise<HealthCheck[]>;

  // ─── Public Lifecycle API ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async init(config: ModuleConfig): Promise<void> {
    if (this.status !== 'uninitialized') throw new Error(`Module ${this.manifest.id} already initialized`);
    this.status = 'initializing';
    this.logger.info('Initializing module', { version: this.manifest.version });

    // Validate config
    const errors = SchemaValidator.validateConfig(config, this.manifest.config);
    if (errors.length > 0) {
      this.status = 'error';
      throw new Error(`Config validation failed: ${errors.join('; ')}`);
    }

    // Apply defaults
    this.config = { ...Object.fromEntries(this.manifest.config.filter(c => c.default !== undefined).map(c => [c.key, c.default])), ...config };

    try {
      await this.onInit(this.config);
      this.status    = 'ready';
      this.startedAt = Date.now();
      this.logger.info('Module initialized successfully');
    } catch (err) {
      this.status = 'error';
      this.logger.fatal('Module initialization failed', err);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    if (!['ready','degraded','error'].includes(this.status)) return;
    this.status = 'stopping';
    this.logger.info('Stopping module');
    try {
      await this.onStop();
      this.status = 'stopped';
    } catch (err) {
      this.status = 'error';
      this.logger.error('Error during module stop', err);
      throw err;
    }
  }

  // ─── Public Action API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async execute(input: ActionInput): Promise<ActionResult> {
    if (this.status !== 'ready' && this.status !== 'degraded')
      return this.errorResult(`Module not ready (status: ${this.status})`, 'MODULE_NOT_READY', false, input.context.requestId);

    // Validate action exists
    const actionSchema = this.manifest.actions.find(a => a.name === input.action);
    if (!actionSchema)
      return this.errorResult(`Unknown action: ${input.action}`, 'UNKNOWN_ACTION', false, input.context.requestId);

    // Validate input
    const validationErrors = SchemaValidator.validateAction(input.payload, actionSchema.input);
    if (validationErrors.length > 0)
      return this.errorResult(`Validation failed: ${validationErrors.join('; ')}`, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', false, input.context.requestId);

    // Check permissions
    for (const perm of this.manifest.permissions) {
      if (!input.context.permissions.includes(perm) && !input.context.permissions.includes('*'))
        return this.errorResult(`Permission denied: ${perm}`, 'PERMISSION_DENIED', false, input.context.requestId);
    }

    // Rate limiting
    if (actionSchema.rateLimit) {
      const key = `${this.manifest.id}:${input.action}:${input.context.tenantId}`;
      if (!this.throttle.check(key, actionSchema.rateLimit))
        return this.errorResult('Rate limit exceeded', 'RATE_LIMITED', true, input.context.requestId);
    }

    const startTime = Date.now();
    try {
      const result = await this.handle(input);
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      result.metadata = { ...result.metadata, duration, requestId: input.context.requestId, timestamp: Date.now(), attempt: 1, cached: false, rateThrottled: false };
      this.metrics.record(result.success, duration);
      this.logger.debug(`Action "${input.action}" completed`, { duration, success: result.success });
      return result;
    } catch (err) {
      const duration = Date.now() - startTime;
      this.metrics.record(false, duration);
      this.logger.error(`Action "${input.action}" threw`, err);
      return this.errorResult(String(err), 'INTERNAL_ERROR', true, input.context.requestId, duration);
    }
  }

  // ─── Health API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async health(): Promise<ModuleHealth> {
    const checks  = await this.performHealthChecks().catch(() => [{
      name: 'health_check', status: 'unhealthy' as HealthStatus, message: 'Health check threw', latency: 0,
    }]);
    const overall: HealthStatus = checks.every(c => c.status === 'healthy') ? 'healthy' :
      checks.some(c => c.status === 'unhealthy') ? 'unhealthy' : 'degraded';

    if (overall === 'degraded' || overall === 'unhealthy') this.status = 'degraded';

    return {
      status:    overall,
      checks,
      uptime:    this.startedAt ? Date.now() - this.startedAt : 0,
      lastCheck: Date.now(),
      version:   this.manifest.version,
      metrics:   this.metrics.get(),
    };
  }

  // ─── Event Bus ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  emit(name: string, payload: unknown, tenantId: string, traceId: string): void {
    const event: ModuleEvent = {
      moduleId:  this.manifest.id,
      name, payload, tenantId, traceId,
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    this.events.push(event);
    if (this.events.length > 200) this.events.shift();
    for (const cb of (this.eventListeners.get(name) ?? [])) { try { cb(event); } catch {} }
    for (const cb of (this.eventListeners.get('*') ?? []))  { try { cb(event); } catch {} }
  }

  on(eventName: string, cb: (event: ModuleEvent) => void): () => void {
    if (!this.eventListeners.has(eventName)) this.eventListeners.set(eventName, []);
    this.eventListeners.get(eventName)!.push(cb);
    return () => {
      const list = this.eventListeners.get(eventName) ?? [];
      this.eventListeners.set(eventName, list.filter(l => l !== cb));
    };
  }

  // ─── Introspection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  getStatus():  ModuleStatus  { return this.status;  }
  getMetrics(): ModuleMetrics { return this.metrics.get(); }
  getManifest(): ModuleManifest { return this.manifest; }
  getEvents(limit = 50): ModuleEvent[] { return this.events.slice(-limit); }
  getLogs(level?: LogLevel): ReturnType<ModuleLogger['getLogs']> { return this.logger.getLogs(level); }

  // ─── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  protected success<T>(data: T): ActionResult<T> {
    return { success: true, data, metadata: { duration: 0, attempt: 1, cached: false, rateThrottled: false, requestId: '', timestamp: Date.now() } };
  }

  protected fail(code: string, message: string, retryable = false): ActionResult {
    return { success: false, error: { code, message, retryable }, metadata: { duration: 0, attempt: 1, cached: false, rateThrottled: false, requestId: '', timestamp: Date.now() } };
  }

  private errorResult(message: string, code: string, retryable: boolean, requestId: string, duration = 0): ActionResult {
    return {
      success: false,
      error: { code, message, retryable },
      metadata: { duration, attempt: 1, cached: false, rateThrottled: false, requestId, timestamp: Date.now() },
    };
  }
}

// ─── Module Registry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ModuleRegistry {
  private modules: Map<string, BaseModule> = new Map();

  register(module: BaseModule): void {
    const { id, version } = module.manifest;
    // Check dependency versions
    for (const dep of module.manifest.dependencies) {
      if (!dep.optional && !this.modules.has(dep.moduleId))
        throw new Error(`Module "${id}" requires "${dep.moduleId}" which is not registered`);
    }
    this.modules.set(`${id}@${version}`, module);
    this.modules.set(id, module); // also register without version for latest
  }

  get(id: string, version?: string): BaseModule | null {
    return this.modules.get(version ? `${id}@${version}` : id) ?? null;
  }

  list(): BaseModule[] {
    return Array.from(new Set(this.modules.values()));
  }

  async healthAll(): Promise<Record<string, ModuleHealth>> {
    const out: Record<string, ModuleHealth> = {};
    for (const mod of this.list()) {
      out[mod.manifest.id] = await mod.health();
    }
    return out;
  }

  unregister(id: string): void {
    const mod = this.modules.get(id);
    if (mod) {
      this.modules.delete(id);
      this.modules.delete(`${id}@${mod.manifest.version}`);
    }
  }
}

export default BaseModule;
import {
  UBEConfig, UBEResponse, UBERequestOptions, ResponseMeta,
  UBEEnvironment, UBERegion, UBETier, LogLevel, SDKRetryPolicy,
  RetryStrategy, HealthStatus, UsageStats, SDKEvent, SDKLogger,

export const DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS: Record<UBEEnvironment, string> = {
  [UBEEnvironment.CLOUD]: 'https://ube-production-2fd4.up.railway.app',
  [UBEEnvironment.SOVEREIGN]: '',
  [UBEEnvironment.LOCAL]: 'http://localhost:3000',
  [UBEEnvironment.EDGE]: 'https://edge.ube.dev',
};

export const DEFAULT_CONFIG: Required<Pick<UBEConfig,
  'timeout' | 'logLevel' | 'compression' | 'keepAlive' | 'maxConnections'
>> = {
  timeout: 30000,
  logLevel: LogLevel.INFO,
  compression: true,
  keepAlive: true,
  maxConnections: 10,
};

// ============================================================
// REQUEST QUEUE
// ============================================================

class RequestQueue {
  private readonly queue: Array<() => Promise<void>> = [];
  private running: number = 0;
  private readonly maxConcurrent: number;

  constructor(maxConcurrent: number = 10) {
    this.maxConcurrent = maxConcurrent;
  }

  async add<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> {
    return new Promise<T>((resolve, reject) => {
      this.queue.push(async () => {
        try { resolve(await fn()); }
        catch (err) { reject(err); }
      });
      this.drain();
    });
  }

  private async drain(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.queue.length > 0 && this.running < this.maxConcurrent) {
      const fn = this.queue.shift();
      if (!fn) break;
      this.running++;
      fn().finally(() => {
        this.running--;
        this.drain();
      });
    }
  }

  get size(): number { return this.queue.length; }
  get active(): number { return this.running; }
}

// ============================================================
// RATE LIMITER
// ============================================================

class ClientRateLimiter {
  private windows: Map<string, { count: number; resetAt: Date }> = new Map();

  check(key: string, limit: number, windowMs: number): boolean {
    const now = new Date();
    const existing = this.windows.get(key);
    if (!existing || existing.resetAt < now) {
      this.windows.set(key, { count: 1, resetAt: new Date(now.getTime() + windowMs) });
      return true;
    }
    if (existing.count >= limit) return false;
    existing.count++;
    return true;
  }

  getResetAt(key: string): Date {
    return this.windows.get(key)?.resetAt || new Date();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// RESPONSE CACHE
// ============================================================

class ResponseCache {
  private readonly cache: Map<string, { data: unknown; expiresAt: Date }> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 200) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  set(key: string, data: unknown, ttlMs: number): void {
    if (this.cache.size >= this.maxSize) {
      const oldest = this.cache.keys().next().value;
      if (oldest) this.cache.delete(oldest);
    }
    this.cache.set(key, { data, expiresAt: new Date(Date.now() + ttlMs) });
  }

  get(key: string): unknown | undefined {
    const entry = this.cache.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (entry.expiresAt < new Date()) {
      this.cache.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    return entry.data;
  }

  invalidate(pattern?: string): void {
    if (!pattern) { this.cache.clear(); return; }
    for (const key of this.cache.keys()) {
      if (key.includes(pattern)) this.cache.delete(key);
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CONSOLE LOGGER
// ============================================================

export class ConsoleLogger implements SDKLogger {
  private readonly level: LogLevel;
  private readonly prefix: string;

  constructor(level: LogLevel = LogLevel.INFO, prefix: string = '[UBE]') {
    this.level = level;
    this.prefix = prefix;
  }

  private shouldLog(level: LogLevel): boolean {
    const levels = [LogLevel.TRACE, LogLevel.DEBUG, LogLevel.INFO, LogLevel.WARN, LogLevel.ERROR, LogLevel.SILENT];
    return levels.indexOf(level) >= levels.indexOf(this.level);
  }

  trace(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.TRACE)) console.debug(`${this.prefix} TRACE ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  debug(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.DEBUG)) console.debug(`${this.prefix} DEBUG ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  info(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.INFO)) console.info(`${this.prefix} INFO ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  warn(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.WARN)) console.warn(`${this.prefix} WARN ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
  error(msg: string, data?: unknown): void {
    if (this.shouldLog(LogLevel.ERROR)) console.error(`${this.prefix} ERROR ${msg}`, data || '');
  }
}

// ============================================================
// METRICS COLLECTOR
// ============================================================

class MetricsCollector {
  private requests: number = 0;
  private errors: number = 0;
  private totalLatency: number = 0;
  private readonly byEndpoint: Map<string, { count: number; totalMs: number; errors: number }> = new Map();
  readonly startTime: Date = new Date();

  record(endpoint: string, latencyMs: number, success: boolean): void {
    this.requests++;
    this.totalLatency += latencyMs;
    if (!success) this.errors++;

    const existing = this.byEndpoint.get(endpoint) || { count: 0, totalMs: 0, errors: 0 };
    existing.count++;
    existing.totalMs += latencyMs;
    if (!success) existing.errors++;
    this.byEndpoint.set(endpoint, existing);
  }

  get stats() {
    return {
      totalRequests: this.requests,
      totalErrors: this.errors,
      errorRate: this.requests > 0 ? this.errors / this.requests : 0,
      averageLatencyMs: this.requests > 0 ? this.totalLatency / this.requests : 0,
      uptime: Date.now() - this.startTime.getTime(),
    };
  }
}

// ============================================================
// WEBHOOK MANAGER
// ============================================================

class WebhookManager {
  private readonly webhooks: Map<string, WebhookConfig> = new Map();
  private readonly handlers: Map<WebhookEvent, ((payload: WebhookPayload) => void)[]> = new Map();

  register(config: WebhookConfig): string {
    const id = config.id || crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    this.webhooks.set(id, { ...config, id });
    return id;
  }

  on(event: WebhookEvent, handler: (payload: WebhookPayload) => void): void {
    const existing = this.handlers.get(event) || [];
    existing.push(handler);
    this.handlers.set(event, existing);
  }

  async dispatch(payload: WebhookPayload): Promise<void> {
    const handlers = this.handlers.get(payload.event) || [];
    await Promise.allSettled(handlers.map(h => Promise.resolve(h(payload))));
  }

  verify(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): boolean {
    try {
      const { createHmac } = require('crypto');
      const expected = createHmac('sha256', secret).update(payload).digest('hex');
      const sigBuffer = Buffer.from(signature.replace('sha256=', ''), 'hex');
      const expBuffer = Buffer.from(expected, 'hex');
      if (sigBuffer.length !== expBuffer.length) return false;
      return require('crypto').timingSafeEqual(sigBuffer, expBuffer);
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// MAIN HTTP CLIENT
// ============================================================

export class UBEHttpClient {
  private readonly endpoint: string;
  private readonly auth: AuthManager;
  private readonly config: UBEConfig;
  private readonly logger: SDKLogger;
  private readonly queue: RequestQueue;
  private readonly rateLimiter: ClientRateLimiter;
  private readonly cache: ResponseCache;
  private readonly metrics: MetricsCollector;
  readonly webhooks: WebhookManager;
  private lastRateLimit?: RateLimitInfo;
  private eventHandlers: Map<SDKEvent, ((data: unknown) => void)[]> = new Map();

  constructor(config: UBEConfig) {
    this.config = { ...DEFAULT_CONFIG, ...config };
    this.endpoint = this.resolveEndpoint(config);
    this.auth = new AuthManager(this.config, this.endpoint);
    this.logger = config.logger || new ConsoleLogger(config.logLevel || LogLevel.WARN);
    this.queue = new RequestQueue(config.maxConnections || 10);
    this.rateLimiter = new ClientRateLimiter();
    this.cache = new ResponseCache();
    this.metrics = new MetricsCollector();
    this.webhooks = new WebhookManager();
  }

  private resolveEndpoint(config: UBEConfig): string {
    if (config.endpoint) return config.endpoint.replace(/\/$/, '');
    const env = config.environment || UBEEnvironment.CLOUD;
    return DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS[env] || DEFAULT_ENDPOINTS[UBEEnvironment.CLOUD];
  }

  async get<T>(path: string, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('GET', path, undefined, options);
  }

  async post<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('POST', path, body, options);
  }

  async put<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PUT', path, body, options);
  }

  async patch<T>(path: string, body?: unknown, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('PATCH', path, body, options);
  }

  async delete<T>(path: string, options: UBERequestOptions = {}): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.request<T>('DELETE', path, undefined, options);
  }

  private async request<T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options: UBERequestOptions = {}
  ): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    return this.queue.add(() => this.executeRequest<T>(method, path, body, options));
  }

  private async executeRequest<T>(
    method: string,
    path: string,
    body?: unknown,
    options: UBERequestOptions = {}
  ): Promise<UBEResponse<T>> {
    const policy = options.retryPolicy || this.config.retryPolicy || { maxAttempts: 3, strategy: RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL_JITTER, baseDelayMs: 500, maxDelayMs: 10000 };
    const url = `${this.endpoint}${path}`;
    const bodyStr = body ? JSON.stringify(body) : '';
    const start = Date.now();
    let lastError: Error | undefined;

    for (let attempt = 0; attempt < policy.maxAttempts; attempt++) {
      if (attempt > 0) {
        const delay = this.computeDelay(attempt, policy);
        this.logger.debug(`Retry ${attempt}/${policy.maxAttempts - 1} after ${delay}ms`, { url, attempt });
        await this.sleep(delay);
      }

      try {
        const authHeaders = await this.auth.getHeaders(method, path, bodyStr);
        const headers: Record<string, string> = {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          'Accept': 'application/json',
          'X-UBE-SDK-Version': '1.0.0',
          'X-UBE-SDK-Language': 'typescript',
          'User-Agent': this.config.userAgent || 'ube-sdk/1.0.0 (typescript)',
          ...(options.traceId ? { 'X-Trace-ID': options.traceId } : {}),
          ...(options.idempotencyKey ? { 'X-Idempotency-Key': options.idempotencyKey } : {}),
          ...this.config.customHeaders,
          ...options.headers,
          ...authHeaders as Record<string, string>,
        };

        this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_START, { method, url, attempt });

        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeout = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), options.timeout || this.config.timeout || 30000);
        const signal = options.signal
          ? this.mergeSignals(options.signal, controller.signal)
          : controller.signal;

        let res: Response;
        try {
          res = await fetch(url, {
            method,
            headers,
            body: body ? bodyStr : undefined,
            signal,
          });
        } finally {
          clearTimeout(timeout);
        }

        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        this.extractRateLimit(res.headers);

        if (res.status === 429) {
          const retryAfter = parseInt(res.headers.get('Retry-After') || '60') * 1000;
          throw new UBERateLimitError(
            'Rate limit exceeded',
            parseInt(res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit') || '0'),
            parseInt(res.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining') || '0'),
            new Date(Date.now() + retryAfter),
            retryAfter
          );
        }

        let data: unknown;
        const contentType = res.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
        if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
          data = await res.json();
        } else {
          data = await res.text();
        }

        if (!res.ok) {
          const errData = data as { error?: { code: string; message: string; retryable?: boolean } };
          if (errData?.error) {
            throw UBEErrorFactory.fromResponse({
              code: errData.error.code,
              message: errData.error.message,
              retryable: errData.error.retryable ?? false,
            });
          }
          throw UBEErrorFactory.fromHTTPStatus(res.status, `HTTP ${res.status}`);
        }

        const meta: ResponseMeta = {
          requestId: res.headers.get('X-Request-ID') || '',
          traceId: options.traceId || res.headers.get('X-Trace-ID') || '',
          timestamp: new Date(),
          processingMs: latency,
          rateLimit: this.lastRateLimit,
          version: res.headers.get('X-UBE-Version') || '1.0.0',
          region: res.headers.get('X-UBE-Region') || undefined,
        };

        this.metrics.record(path, latency, true);
        this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_END, { method, url, latency, status: res.status });
        this.logger.trace(`${method} ${path} → ${res.status} (${latency}ms)`);

        const responseData = data as { data?: T; success?: boolean };
        return {
          success: true,
          data: responseData?.data !== undefined ? responseData.data : data as T,
          meta,
        };

      } catch (err) {
        const latency = Date.now() - start;
        lastError = err as Error;

        if (err instanceof Error && err.name === 'AbortError') {
          throw new UBETimeoutError(`Request aborted: ${url}`, options.timeout || 30000);
        }

        if (!isRetryableError(err) || attempt === policy.maxAttempts - 1) {
          this.metrics.record(path, latency, false);
          this.emit(SDKEvent.REQUEST_ERROR, { method, url, error: err });
          throw err;
        }

        this.logger.warn(`Request failed (attempt ${attempt + 1}), retrying...`, { error: String(err) });
      }
    }

    throw lastError || new UBEError('UNKNOWN' as any, 'Request failed after all retries');
  }

  private computeDelay(attempt: number, policy: SDKRetryPolicy): number {
    let delay: number;
    switch (policy.strategy) {
      case RetryStrategy.FIXED:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs;
        break;
      case RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        break;
      case RetryStrategy.EXPONENTIAL_JITTER:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1);
        delay += Math.random() * delay * 0.1;
        break;
      default:
        delay = policy.baseDelayMs;
    }
    return Math.min(delay, policy.maxDelayMs);
  }

  private extractRateLimit(headers: Headers): void {
    const limit = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit');
    const remaining = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining');
    const reset = headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset');
    if (limit && remaining) {
      this.lastRateLimit = {
        limit: parseInt(limit),
        remaining: parseInt(remaining),
        resetAt: reset ? new Date(parseInt(reset) * 1000) : new Date(Date.now() + 60000),
        window: '1m',
      };
    }
  }

  private mergeSignals(s1: AbortSignal, s2: AbortSignal): AbortSignal {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    const abort = () => controller.abort();
    s1.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    s2.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
    return controller.signal;
  }

  private sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
  }

  on(event: SDKEvent, handler: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    const existing = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    existing.push(handler);
    this.eventHandlers.set(event, existing);
  }

  off(event: SDKEvent, handler: (data: unknown) => void): void {
    const existing = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    this.eventHandlers.set(event, existing.filter(h => h !== handler));
  }

  private emit(event: SDKEvent, data: unknown): void {
    const handlers = this.eventHandlers.get(event) || [];
    for (const handler of handlers) {
      try { handler(data); } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
    }
    if (this.config.onEvent) {
      try { this.config.onEvent(event, data); } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
    }
  }

  getMetrics() { return this.metrics.stats; }
  getRateLimit(): RateLimitInfo | undefined { return this.lastRateLimit; }
  getAuth(): AuthManager { return this.auth; }
  getEndpoint(): string { return this.endpoint; }
  invalidateCache(pattern?: string): void { this.cache.invalidate(pattern); }

  async ping(): Promise<number> {
    const start = Date.now();
    await this.get('/health');
    return Date.now() - start;
  }

  destroy(): void {
    this.auth.destroy();
    this.cache.invalidate();
    this.eventHandlers.clear();
  }
}

// ============================================================
// CRYPTO HELPER (for randomUUID in non-Node environments)
// ============================================================

function generateId(): string {
  try {
    return crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() :
      Array.from({ length: 16 }, () => Math.floor(Math.random() * 256).toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
  } catch {
    return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) + Date.now().toString(36);
  }
}
