  getStats(): SatelliteRouterStats {
    return { ...this.stats, uptime: Date.now() - this.stats.startedAt };
  }

  getLinkMetrics(): LinkMetrics[] {
    return this.links.map(l => l.getMetrics());
  }

  private async processQueue(): Promise<void> {
    while (this.queue.size() > 0) {
      const link = this.selector.select('normal');
      if (!link) break;

      const msg = this.queue.dequeue();
      if (!msg) break;

      const result = await link.send(msg.data, { priority: msg.priority });
      if (result.success) {
        this.stats.totalSent++;
        this.stats.totalBytesSent += msg.data.length;
        this.emit('message:delivered', { id: msg.id, latencyMs: Date.now() - msg.queuedAt });
      } else {
        msg.attempts++;
        if (msg.attempts < msg.maxAttempts && msg.expiresAt > Date.now()) {
          this.queue.enqueue(msg); // Re-queue
        } else {
          this.stats.totalFailed++;
          this.emit('message:dropped', { id: msg.id, attempts: msg.attempts });
        }
      }
    }
    this.stats.queueDepth = this.queue.size();
  }

  private async healthChecks(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.allSettled(this.links.map(l => l.healthCheck()));
    this.updateStats();
  }

  private updateStats(): void {
    const available = this.selector.available();
    this.stats.linksAvailable = available.length;
    if (available.length > 0) {
      this.stats.activeLink = this.selector.select()?.provider ?? null;
    } else {
      this.stats.activeLink = null;
    }
  }
}

export default SatelliteRouter;
/**
 * UBE Phase 11 — powerSovereignty.ts
 * Energy Sovereignty: Solar MPPT, Battery SOC, Load Shedding, RF Harvesting
 *
 * A node that runs out of power ceases to exist. Power sovereignty means the
 * node controls its own energy: harvests from solar/RF/thermal, stores in
 * batteries, budgets consumption by operation priority, and degrades gracefully
 * rather than dying suddenly. The mesh stays alive even when grid power is gone.
 *
 * Components:
 *   MPPTController       — Maximum Power Point Tracking for solar panels (P&O algorithm)
 *   BatteryMonitor       — State of Charge via Coulomb counting + Kalman filter
 *   LoadSheddingEngine   — Priority-based load shedding under power constraints
 *   RFEnergyHarvester    — Ambient RF energy harvesting from WiFi/cellular/broadcast
 *   ThermalHarvester     — Peltier/thermoelectric generation from temperature gradients
 *   PowerBudgetManager   — Per-operation energy accounting
 *   UPSController        — Seamless switchover between power sources
 *   PowerSovereigntyNode — Orchestrator: keeps node alive under any power condition
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import * as crypto from 'crypto';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

const MPPT_PERTURBATION_STEP_V = 0.05;   // Voltage perturbation step (V)
const MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000;   // MPPT update interval
const BATTERY_CAPACITY_WH_DEFAULT = 100; // Wh (LiFePO4 100Wh default)
const BATTERY_CELL_NOMINAL_V = 3.2;      // LiFePO4 nominal voltage
const BATTERY_FULL_V = 3.65;             // LiFePO4 full charge voltage
const BATTERY_EMPTY_V = 2.80;            // LiFePO4 cutoff voltage
const COULOMB_EFFICIENCY = 0.98;         // Coulombic efficiency of LiFePO4
const KALMAN_PROCESS_NOISE = 0.001;      // SOC process noise variance
const KALMAN_MEASUREMENT_NOISE = 0.01;   // Voltage measurement noise variance
const THERMAL_THROTTLE_TEMP_C = 70;      // CPU throttle temperature
const THERMAL_SHUTDOWN_TEMP_C = 85;      // Emergency shutdown temperature
const RF_HARVEST_EFFICIENCY = 0.15;      // Typical RF-to-DC conversion efficiency
const LOAD_SHED_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 5_000;
const POWER_LOG_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TYPES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PowerSource = 'solar' | 'battery' | 'grid' | 'rf_harvest' | 'thermal' | 'wind' | 'usb';
export type BatteryChemistry = 'lifepo4' | 'li_ion' | 'lead_acid' | 'nimh' | 'supercap';
export type LoadClass = 'critical' | 'high' | 'normal' | 'low' | 'background' | 'idle';
export type PowerState = 'full' | 'normal' | 'conservation' | 'emergency' | 'critical' | 'shutdown';

export interface SolarPanel {
  id: string;
  peakWatts: number;          // Rated peak power (W)
  voc: number;                // Open circuit voltage (V)
  isc: number;                // Short circuit current (A)
  vmp: number;                // Max power point voltage (V)
  imp: number;                // Max power point current (A)
  tempCoeffPmax: number;      // Temperature coefficient of Pmax (%/°C)
  currentVoltage: number;     // Current operating voltage
  currentCurrent: number;     // Current operating current
  temperature: number;        // Panel temperature (°C)
}

export interface Battery {
  id: string;
  chemistry: BatteryChemistry;
  capacityWh: number;
  capacityAh: number;
  nominalVoltage: number;
  voltage: number;
  current: number;            // Positive = charging, negative = discharging
  temperature: number;
  cycleCount: number;
  stateOfCharge: number;      // 0.0–1.0
  stateOfHealth: number;      // 0.0–1.0 (1.0 = new)
  internalResistanceOhm: number;
}

export interface PowerLoad {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  class: LoadClass;
  nominalWatts: number;
  currentWatts: number;
  canShed: boolean;
  shedOrder: number;          // Lower = shed first
  enabled: boolean;
  minOnTimeMs: number;        // Must stay on at least this long
  lastToggle: number;
}

export interface PowerSnapshot {
  timestamp: number;
  source: PowerSource;
  solarWatts: number;
  batteryWatts: number;       // Positive = discharging
  loadWatts: number;
  rfHarvestWatts: number;
  thermalWatts: number;
  gridWatts: number;
  netWatts: number;           // Positive = charging
  batterySOC: number;
  batteryVoltage: number;
  batteryTemperature: number;
  powerState: PowerState;
  loadsActive: number;
  loadsShed: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MPPT CONTROLLER — Perturb & Observe Algorithm
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class MPPTController extends EventEmitter {
  private panels: Map<string, SolarPanel> = new Map();
  private voltageSetpoints: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private prevPower: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private prevVoltage: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private perturbDirection: Map<string, number> = new Map(); // +1 or -1
  private trackingTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private totalOutputWatts: number = 0;

  addPanel(panel: SolarPanel): void {
    this.panels.set(panel.id, panel);
    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panel.id, panel.vmp);
    this.prevPower.set(panel.id, 0);
    this.prevVoltage.set(panel.id, panel.vmp);
    this.perturbDirection.set(panel.id, 1);
  }

  startTracking(): void {
    this.trackingTimer = setInterval(() => this.updateAllPanels(), MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS);
  }

  stopTracking(): void {
    if (this.trackingTimer) clearInterval(this.trackingTimer);
  }

  // P&O MPPT update for one panel
  updatePanel(panelId: string, measuredVoltage: number, measuredCurrent: number): void {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return;

    panel.currentVoltage = measuredVoltage;
    panel.currentCurrent = measuredCurrent;

    const currentPower = measuredVoltage * measuredCurrent;
    const prevP = this.prevPower.get(panelId) ?? 0;
    const prevV = this.prevVoltage.get(panelId) ?? panel.vmp;
    const direction = this.perturbDirection.get(panelId) ?? 1;

    const dP = currentPower - prevP;
    const dV = measuredVoltage - prevV;

    let newDirection = direction;
    if (Math.abs(dP) > 0.001) {
      // If power increased, continue same direction; if decreased, reverse
      newDirection = dP > 0 ? direction : -direction;
    }

    const newSetpoint = this.voltageSetpoints.get(panelId)! + newDirection * MPPT_PERTURBATION_STEP_V;
    const clampedSetpoint = Math.max(panel.vmp * 0.7, Math.min(panel.voc * 0.95, newSetpoint));

    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panelId, clampedSetpoint);
    this.prevPower.set(panelId, currentPower);
    this.prevVoltage.set(panelId, measuredVoltage);
    this.perturbDirection.set(panelId, newDirection);

    this.totalOutputWatts = this.computeTotalOutput();
    this.emit('mppt:update', { panelId, power: currentPower, voltage: measuredVoltage, setpoint: clampedSetpoint });
  }

  // Temperature correction for panel efficiency
  temperatureCorrect(panelId: string, temperature: number): void {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return;
    panel.temperature = temperature;
    // Standard test condition is 25°C
    const deltaT = temperature - 25;
    const correctedVmp = panel.vmp * (1 + panel.tempCoeffPmax / 100 * deltaT);
    // Adjust setpoint to compensate
    this.voltageSetpoints.set(panelId, correctedVmp);
  }

  getSetpoint(panelId: string): number {
    return this.voltageSetpoints.get(panelId) ?? 0;
  }

  getTotalOutputWatts(): number {
    return this.totalOutputWatts;
  }

  getEfficiency(panelId: string): number {
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return 0;
    const actual = panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    const theoretical = panel.peakWatts;
    return theoretical > 0 ? actual / theoretical : 0;
  }

  getIrradiance(panelId: string): number {
    // Estimate irradiance from current power vs rated power
    const panel = this.panels.get(panelId);
    if (!panel) return 0;
    const power = panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    return (power / panel.peakWatts) * 1000; // W/m²
  }

  private updateAllPanels(): void {
    for (const panel of this.panels.values()) {
      // In production: read ADC for voltage and current
      // Simulation: slight random variation around MPP
      const irradiance = 800 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 200;
      const simVoltage = panel.vmp * (0.95 + Math.random() * 0.05);
      const simCurrent = panel.imp * (irradiance / 1000) * (0.9 + Math.random() * 0.1);
      this.updatePanel(panel.id, simVoltage, simCurrent);
    }
  }

  private computeTotalOutput(): number {
    let total = 0;
    for (const panel of this.panels.values()) {
      total += panel.currentVoltage * panel.currentCurrent;
    }
    return total;
  }

  panelCount(): number { return this.panels.size; }
  allPanels(): SolarPanel[] { return Array.from(this.panels.values()); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// BATTERY MONITOR — Coulomb Counting + Kalman Filter SOC
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface KalmanState {
  soc: number;           // State of charge estimate
  variance: number;      // Estimation uncertainty
}

export class BatteryMonitor extends EventEmitter {
  private batteries: Map<string, Battery> = new Map();
  private kalmanStates: Map<string, KalmanState> = new Map();
  private lastSampleTime: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private monitorTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  addBattery(battery: Battery): void {
    this.batteries.set(battery.id, battery);
    this.kalmanStates.set(battery.id, { soc: battery.stateOfCharge, variance: 0.1 });
    this.lastSampleTime.set(battery.id, Date.now());
  }

  update(batteryId: string, voltage: number, current: number, temperature: number): void {
    const battery = this.batteries.get(batteryId);
    if (!battery) return;

    const now = Date.now();
    const dtHours = (now - (this.lastSampleTime.get(batteryId) ?? now)) / 3_600_000;
    this.lastSampleTime.set(batteryId, now);

    battery.voltage = voltage;
    battery.current = current;
    battery.temperature = temperature;

    // Coulomb counting: integrate current over time
    const coulombDelta = (current * dtHours * COULOMB_EFFICIENCY) / battery.capacityAh;
    const coulombSOC = battery.stateOfCharge + coulombDelta;

    // OCV-based SOC estimate (Open Circuit Voltage method)
    const ocvSOC = this.ocvToSOC(battery.chemistry, voltage + current * battery.internalResistanceOhm);

    // Kalman filter fusion
    const kalman = this.kalmanStates.get(batteryId)!;
    const predicted = kalman.soc + coulombDelta;
    const predictedVariance = kalman.variance + KALMAN_PROCESS_NOISE;

    // Kalman gain
    const K = predictedVariance / (predictedVariance + KALMAN_MEASUREMENT_NOISE);
    const updated = predicted + K * (ocvSOC - predicted);
    const updatedVariance = (1 - K) * predictedVariance;

    this.kalmanStates.set(batteryId, { soc: updated, variance: updatedVariance });
    battery.stateOfCharge = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, updated));

    // Health estimation: capacity fade from cycle count
    battery.stateOfHealth = Math.max(0.5, 1 - battery.cycleCount * 0.0001);

    // Internal resistance estimation via voltage sag
    if (Math.abs(current) > 0.1) {
      const sagV = Math.abs(voltage - this.ocvFromSOC(battery.chemistry, battery.stateOfCharge));
      battery.internalResistanceOhm = sagV / Math.abs(current);
    }

    this.emit('battery:update', {
      id: batteryId,
      soc: battery.stateOfCharge,
      voltage,
      current,
      temperature,
      stateOfHealth: battery.stateOfHealth,
    });

    // Thermal protection
    if (temperature > THERMAL_THROTTLE_TEMP_C) {
      this.emit('battery:thermal_warning', { id: batteryId, temperature });
    }
    if (temperature > THERMAL_SHUTDOWN_TEMP_C) {
      this.emit('battery:thermal_critical', { id: batteryId, temperature });
    }
  }

  estimateRemainingHours(batteryId: string, loadWatts: number): number {
    const battery = this.batteries.get(batteryId);
    if (!battery || loadWatts <= 0) return Infinity;
    const availableWh = battery.stateOfCharge * battery.capacityWh * battery.stateOfHealth;
    return availableWh / loadWatts;
  }

  getSOC(batteryId: string): number {
    return this.batteries.get(batteryId)?.stateOfCharge ?? 0;
  }

  getTotalSOC(): number {
    const batteries = Array.from(this.batteries.values());
    if (batteries.length === 0) return 0;
    const totalWh = batteries.reduce((s, b) => s + b.capacityWh, 0);
    const availWh = batteries.reduce((s, b) => s + b.stateOfCharge * b.capacityWh, 0);
    return totalWh > 0 ? availWh / totalWh : 0;
  }

  getAggregatedCapacityWh(): number {
    return Array.from(this.batteries.values()).reduce((s, b) => s + b.capacityWh * b.stateOfHealth, 0);
  }

  startMonitoring(): void {
    this.monitorTimer = setInterval(() => {
      for (const battery of this.batteries.values()) {
        // In production: read from ADC/BMS via I2C/SPI
        this.emit('battery:poll', { id: battery.id });
      }
    }, 5_000);
  }

  stopMonitoring(): void {
    if (this.monitorTimer) clearInterval(this.monitorTimer);
  }

  // OCV → SOC lookup table (LiFePO4 characteristic curve)
  private ocvToSOC(chemistry: BatteryChemistry, voltage: number): number {
    const curves: Record<BatteryChemistry, Array<[number, number]>> = {
      lifepo4: [
        [2.80, 0.00], [3.00, 0.05], [3.10, 0.10], [3.20, 0.20],
        [3.25, 0.40], [3.30, 0.60], [3.35, 0.80], [3.45, 0.95], [3.65, 1.00],
      ],
      li_ion: [
        [3.00, 0.00], [3.30, 0.10], [3.60, 0.30], [3.80, 0.60],
        [4.00, 0.80], [4.10, 0.90], [4.20, 1.00],
      ],
      lead_acid: [
        [11.8, 0.00], [12.0, 0.20], [12.2, 0.40], [12.4, 0.60],
        [12.6, 0.80], [12.7, 0.90], [12.8, 1.00],
      ],
      nimh: [[1.0, 0.0], [1.2, 0.5], [1.4, 1.0]],
      supercap: [[0.0, 0.0], [2.7, 1.0]],
    };

    const curve = curves[chemistry] ?? curves.lifepo4;
    if (voltage <= curve[0][0]) return 0;
    if (voltage >= curve[curve.length - 1][0]) return 1;

    for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
      if (voltage >= curve[i][0] && voltage < curve[i + 1][0]) {
        const t = (voltage - curve[i][0]) / (curve[i + 1][0] - curve[i][0]);
        return curve[i][1] + t * (curve[i + 1][1] - curve[i][1]);
      }
    }
    return 0.5;
  }

  private ocvFromSOC(chemistry: BatteryChemistry, soc: number): number {
    const lifepo4: Array<[number, number]> = [
      [0.00, 2.80], [0.05, 3.00], [0.10, 3.10], [0.20, 3.20],
      [0.40, 3.25], [0.60, 3.30], [0.80, 3.35], [0.95, 3.45], [1.00, 3.65],
    ];
    const curve = chemistry === 'lifepo4' ? lifepo4 : lifepo4;
    for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
      if (soc >= curve[i][0] && soc < curve[i + 1][0]) {
        const t = (soc - curve[i][0]) / (curve[i + 1][0] - curve[i][0]);
        return curve[i][1] + t * (curve[i + 1][1] - curve[i][1]);
      }
    }
    return 3.2;
  }

  allBatteries(): Battery[] { return Array.from(this.batteries.values()); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// RF ENERGY HARVESTER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RFSource {
  frequency: number;    // Hz
  powerDensity: number; // μW/cm²
  type: 'wifi' | 'cellular' | 'broadcast_tv' | 'broadcast_fm' | 'gsm' | 'lte' | '5g';
  antennaSizeM2: number;
}

export interface HarvestResult {
  totalPowerUW: number;   // Microwatts
  totalPowerMW: number;   // Milliwatts
  sources: Array<{ type: string; powerUW: number }>;
  efficiency: number;
  storedEnergy: boolean;
}

export class RFEnergyHarvester extends EventEmitter {
  private sources: RFSource[] = [];
  private harvestedTodayUJ: number = 0;  // Microjoules
  private rectifierEfficiency: number = RF_HARVEST_EFFICIENCY;
  private storageSuperCapacitorUF: number = 1_000; // 1mF storage capacitor
  private storagVoltage: number = 0;
  private readonly storedMaxV: number = 5.0;

  addSource(source: RFSource): void { this.sources.push(source); }

  harvest(): HarvestResult {
    const sourceResults: Array<{ type: string; powerUW: number }> = [];
    let totalPowerUW = 0;

    for (const source of this.sources) {
      // Friis transmission: P_rx = P_tx * G_tx * G_rx * (λ/(4πd))²
      // Simplified: use measured power density directly
      const capturedPowerUW = source.powerDensity * source.antennaSizeM2 * 10_000; // Convert cm² to m²
      const harvestedUW = capturedPowerUW * this.rectifierEfficiency;
      sourceResults.push({ type: source.type, powerUW: harvestedUW });
      totalPowerUW += harvestedUW;
    }

    // Store in supercapacitor: E = ½CV²
    const harvestedJoules = (totalPowerUW * 1e-6) * (MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000);
    const currentEnergy = 0.5 * (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6) * this.storedVoltage ** 2;
    const newEnergy = currentEnergy + harvestedJoules;
    this.storedVoltage = Math.min(
      this.storedMaxV,
      Math.sqrt((2 * newEnergy) / (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6)),
    );

    this.harvestedTodayUJ += totalPowerUW * (MPPT_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS / 1000);
    const stored = this.storedVoltage >= 3.0; // Enough to power MCU

    this.emit('harvest', { totalPowerUW, storedVoltage: this.storedVoltage });
    return {
      totalPowerUW,
      totalPowerMW: totalPowerUW / 1000,
      sources: sourceResults,
      efficiency: this.rectifierEfficiency,
      storedEnergy: stored,
    };
  }

  getStoredVoltage(): number { return this.storedVoltage; }
  getStoredEnergyUJ(): number {
    return 0.5 * (this.storageSuperCapacitorUF * 1e-6) * this.storedVoltage ** 2 * 1e6;
  }
  getHarvestedTodayUJ(): number { return this.harvestedTodayUJ; }

  private get storedVoltage(): number { return this.storagVoltage; }
  private set storedVoltage(v: number) { this.storagVoltage = v; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// LOAD SHEDDING ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ShedEvent {
  loadId: string;
  action: 'shed' | 'restore';
  reason: PowerState;
  timestamp: number;
  previousWatts: number;
}

export class LoadSheddingEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private loads: Map<string, PowerLoad> = new Map();
  private shedHistory: ShedEvent[] = [];

  addLoad(load: PowerLoad): void {
    this.loads.set(load.id, load);
  }

  updateLoad(loadId: string, currentWatts: number): void {
    const load = this.loads.get(loadId);
    if (load) load.currentWatts = currentWatts;
  }

  // Determine which loads to shed for a given power state
  computeShedding(powerState: PowerState, availableWatts: number): {
    toShed: PowerLoad[];
    toRestore: PowerLoad[];
    projectedLoad: number;
  } {
    const now = Date.now();
    const thresholds: Record<PowerState, { maxLoadFraction: number }> = {
      full: { maxLoadFraction: 1.0 },
      normal: { maxLoadFraction: 0.9 },
      conservation: { maxLoadFraction: 0.6 },
      emergency: { maxLoadFraction: 0.3 },
      critical: { maxLoadFraction: 0.15 },
      shutdown: { maxLoadFraction: 0.05 },
    };

    const maxLoad = availableWatts * thresholds[powerState].maxLoadFraction;
    const allLoads = Array.from(this.loads.values()).sort((a, b) => a.shedOrder - b.shedOrder);

    let totalLoad = 0;
    const toShed: PowerLoad[] = [];
    const toRestore: PowerLoad[] = [];

    for (const load of allLoads) {
      const canToggle = now - load.lastToggle > load.minOnTimeMs;

      if (load.enabled) {
        if (totalLoad + load.currentWatts <= maxLoad) {
          totalLoad += load.currentWatts;
        } else if (load.canShed && canToggle && powerState !== 'full' && powerState !== 'normal') {
          toShed.push(load);
        } else {
          totalLoad += load.currentWatts;
        }
      } else {
        // Consider restoring if we have headroom
        if (totalLoad + load.nominalWatts <= maxLoad * 0.85 && powerState !== 'critical' && powerState !== 'shutdown') {
          toRestore.push(load);
          totalLoad += load.nominalWatts;
        }
      }
    }

    return { toShed, toRestore, projectedLoad: totalLoad };
  }

  applyShedding(toShed: PowerLoad[], toRestore: PowerLoad[], reason: PowerState): void {
    const now = Date.now();

    for (const load of toShed) {
      if (load.enabled) {
        this.shedHistory.push({ loadId: load.id, action: 'shed', reason, timestamp: now, previousWatts: load.currentWatts });
        load.enabled = false;
        load.lastToggle = now;
        this.emit('load:shed', { load, reason });
      }
    }

    for (const load of toRestore) {
      if (!load.enabled) {
        this.shedHistory.push({ loadId: load.id, action: 'restore', reason, timestamp: now, previousWatts: 0 });
        load.enabled = true;
        load.lastToggle = now;
        this.emit('load:restore', { load, reason });
      }
    }
  }

  getTotalLoad(): number {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => l.enabled).reduce((s, l) => s + l.currentWatts, 0);
  }

  getEnabledLoads(): PowerLoad[] {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => l.enabled);
  }

  getShedLoads(): PowerLoad[] {
    return Array.from(this.loads.values()).filter(l => !l.enabled);
  }

  getShedHistory(limit: number = 100): ShedEvent[] {
    return this.shedHistory.slice(-limit);
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER BUDGET MANAGER — Per-operation energy accounting
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface OperationEnergyCost {
  operationId: string;
  wattsTypical: number;
  durationMs: number;
  priority: LoadClass;
  canDefer: boolean;
}

export interface EnergyBudget {
  availableWh: number;
  reservedWh: number;
  spendableWh: number;
  operations: Map<string, number>; // operationId -> Wh spent
}

export class PowerBudgetManager {
  private costs: Map<string, OperationEnergyCost> = new Map();
  private spentWh: Map<string, number> = new Map();
  private totalCapacityWh: number;
  private reserveFraction: number = 0.20; // Keep 20% reserved

  constructor(totalCapacityWh: number) {
    this.totalCapacityWh = totalCapacityWh;
  }

  registerOperation(cost: OperationEnergyCost): void {
    this.costs.set(cost.operationId, cost);
  }

  canAfford(operationId: string, currentSOC: number): boolean {
    const cost = this.costs.get(operationId);
    if (!cost) return true;

    const availableWh = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh * (1 - this.reserveFraction);
    const costWh = (cost.wattsTypical * cost.durationMs) / 3_600_000;
    return availableWh >= costWh;
  }

  recordUsage(operationId: string, actualWatts: number, durationMs: number): void {
    const usedWh = (actualWatts * durationMs) / 3_600_000;
    const prev = this.spentWh.get(operationId) ?? 0;
    this.spentWh.set(operationId, prev + usedWh);
  }

  getBudget(currentSOC: number): EnergyBudget {
    const available = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh;
    const reserved = this.totalCapacityWh * this.reserveFraction;
    return {
      availableWh: available,
      reservedWh: reserved,
      spendableWh: Math.max(0, available - reserved),
      operations: new Map(this.spentWh),
    };
  }

  estimateBatteryLife(currentSOC: number, loadWatts: number): number {
    const available = currentSOC * this.totalCapacityWh;
    return loadWatts > 0 ? available / loadWatts : Infinity;
  }

  setTotalCapacity(wh: number): void {
    this.totalCapacityWh = wh;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// UPS CONTROLLER — Seamless source switchover
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type SwitchoverReason = 'grid_fail' | 'battery_low' | 'solar_available' | 'manual' | 'optimization';

export interface SwitchoverEvent {
  from: PowerSource;
  to: PowerSource;
  reason: SwitchoverReason;
  timestamp: number;
  batterySOC: number;
  loadWatts: number;
}

export class UPSController extends EventEmitter {
  private currentSource: PowerSource = 'grid';
  private availableSources: Set<PowerSource> = new Set();
  private switchoverHistory: SwitchoverEvent[] = [];
  private readonly switchoverDelayMs: number = 20; // 20ms transfer time (UPS grade)

  declare(source: PowerSource, available: boolean): void {
    if (available) this.availableSources.add(source);
    else this.availableSources.delete(source);
  }

  async switchTo(
    source: PowerSource,
    reason: SwitchoverReason,
    batterySOC: number,
    loadWatts: number,
  ): Promise<boolean> {
    if (!this.availableSources.has(source)) return false;
    if (source === this.currentSource) return true;

    const from = this.currentSource;
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, this.switchoverDelayMs));
    this.currentSource = source;

    const event: SwitchoverEvent = { from, to: source, reason, timestamp: Date.now(), batterySOC, loadWatts };
    this.switchoverHistory.push(event);
    this.emit('switchover', event);
    return true;
  }

  selectBestSource(solarWatts: number, batterySOC: number): PowerSource {
    if (this.availableSources.has('grid')) return 'grid';
    if (solarWatts > 5 && this.availableSources.has('solar')) return 'solar';
    if (batterySOC > 0.1 && this.availableSources.has('battery')) return 'battery';
    if (this.availableSources.has('rf_harvest')) return 'rf_harvest';
    if (this.availableSources.has('thermal')) return 'thermal';
    return 'battery'; // Last resort
  }

  getCurrentSource(): PowerSource { return this.currentSource; }
  getHistory(): SwitchoverEvent[] { return [...this.switchoverHistory]; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER STATE MACHINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function socToPowerState(soc: number, inputWatts: number, loadWatts: number): PowerState {
  const netWatts = inputWatts - loadWatts;
  if (soc >= 0.80 || (soc >= 0.50 && netWatts > 0)) return 'full';
  if (soc >= 0.50) return 'normal';
  if (soc >= 0.30) return 'conservation';
  if (soc >= 0.15) return 'emergency';
  if (soc >= 0.05) return 'critical';
  return 'shutdown';
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// THERMAL HARVESTER
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ThermalHarvester extends EventEmitter {
  private hotSideTemp: number = 60;  // °C (e.g., CPU heat sink)
  private coldSideTemp: number = 25; // °C (ambient)
  private readonly seebeckCoefficient: number = 0.05; // V/K (typical thermoelectric)
  private readonly internalResistanceOhm: number = 3.0;
  private readonly thermalResistance: number = 0.5; // K/W

  update(hotTemp: number, coldTemp: number): void {
    this.hotSideTemp = hotTemp;
    this.coldSideTemp = coldTemp;
    this.emit('thermal:update', { hot: hotTemp, cold: coldTemp, power: this.getOutputWatts() });
  }

  getOpenCircuitVoltage(): number {
    return this.seebeckCoefficient * (this.hotSideTemp - this.coldSideTemp);
  }

  getMaxOutputWatts(): number {
    const voc = this.getOpenCircuitVoltage();
    // Maximum power transfer: load R = internal R
    return (voc * voc) / (4 * this.internalResistanceOhm);
  }

  getOutputWatts(): number {
    return this.getMaxOutputWatts() * 0.7; // Practical efficiency
  }

  getCarnotEfficiency(): number {
    const hotK = this.hotSideTemp + 273.15;
    const coldK = this.coldSideTemp + 273.15;
    return 1 - coldK / hotK;
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// POWER SOVEREIGNTY NODE — Main Orchestrator
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface PowerSovereigntyConfig {
  panels?: SolarPanel[];
  batteries?: Battery[];
  loads?: PowerLoad[];
  enableRFHarvest?: boolean;
  enableThermal?: boolean;
  rfSources?: RFSource[];
  monthlyBatteryBudgetWh?: number;
}

export interface PowerSovereigntyStatus {
  powerState: PowerState;
  activeSource: PowerSource;
  solarWatts: number;
  loadWatts: number;
  batterySOC: number;
  batteryVoltage: number;
  batteryHoursRemaining: number;
  rfHarvestMW: number;
  thermalWatts: number;
  loadsActive: number;
  loadsShed: number;
  powerSelfSufficient: boolean;
  snapshots: PowerSnapshot[];
}

export class PowerSovereigntyNode extends EventEmitter {
  public readonly mppt: MPPTController;
  public readonly batteryMonitor: BatteryMonitor;
  public readonly loadShedder: LoadSheddingEngine;
  public readonly rfHarvester: RFEnergyHarvester;
  public readonly thermalHarvester: ThermalHarvester;
  public readonly budgetManager: PowerBudgetManager;
  public readonly ups: UPSController;

  private powerState: PowerState = 'normal';
  private snapshots: PowerSnapshot[] = [];
  private running: boolean = false;

  private shedCheckTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private logTimer: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

  constructor(config: PowerSovereigntyConfig) {
    super();
    this.mppt = new MPPTController();
    this.batteryMonitor = new BatteryMonitor();
    this.loadShedder = new LoadSheddingEngine();
    this.rfHarvester = new RFEnergyHarvester();
    this.thermalHarvester = new ThermalHarvester();
    this.budgetManager = new PowerBudgetManager(config.monthlyBatteryBudgetWh ?? BATTERY_CAPACITY_WH_DEFAULT);
    this.ups = new UPSController();

    // Register configured components
    if (config.panels) config.panels.forEach(p => this.mppt.addPanel(p));
    if (config.batteries) config.batteries.forEach(b => { this.batteryMonitor.addBattery(b); this.ups.declare('battery', true); });
    if (config.loads) config.loads.forEach(l => this.loadShedder.addLoad(l));
    if (config.rfSources) config.rfSources.forEach(s => this.rfHarvester.addSource(s));

    if (config.panels && config.panels.length > 0) this.ups.declare('solar', true);
    if (config.enableRFHarvest) this.ups.declare('rf_harvest', true);
    if (config.enableThermal) this.ups.declare('thermal', true);

    this.registerDefaultOperations();
    this.wireEvents();
  }

  start(): void {
    this.mppt.startTracking();
    this.batteryMonitor.startMonitoring();
    this.running = true;

    this.shedCheckTimer = setInterval(() => this.runPowerCycle(), LOAD_SHED_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);
    this.logTimer = setInterval(() => this.logSnapshot(), POWER_LOG_INTERVAL_MS);

    this.emit('started');
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.running = false;
    this.mppt.stopTracking();
    this.batteryMonitor.stopMonitoring();
    if (this.shedCheckTimer) clearInterval(this.shedCheckTimer);
    if (this.logTimer) clearInterval(this.logTimer);
    this.emit('stopped');
  }

  canRun(operationId: string): boolean {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    return this.budgetManager.canAfford(operationId, soc);
  }

  recordOperationUsage(operationId: string, watts: number, durationMs: number): void {
    this.budgetManager.recordUsage(operationId, watts, durationMs);
  }

  getStatus(): PowerSovereigntyStatus {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    const battVoltage = this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]?.voltage ?? 0;
    const solarWatts = this.mppt.getTotalOutputWatts();
    const loadWatts = this.loadShedder.getTotalLoad();
    const rfResult = this.rfHarvester.harvest();
    const thermalWatts = this.thermalHarvester.getOutputWatts();

    return {
      powerState: this.powerState,
      activeSource: this.ups.getCurrentSource(),
      solarWatts,
      loadWatts,
      batterySOC: soc,
      batteryVoltage: battVoltage,
      batteryHoursRemaining: this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]
        ? this.batteryMonitor.estimateRemainingHours(this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0].id, loadWatts)
        : 0,
      rfHarvestMW: rfResult.totalPowerMW,
      thermalWatts,
      loadsActive: this.loadShedder.getEnabledLoads().length,
      loadsShed: this.loadShedder.getShedLoads().length,
      powerSelfSufficient: solarWatts + rfResult.totalPowerMW / 1000 + thermalWatts >= loadWatts,
      snapshots: this.snapshots.slice(-60),
    };
  }

  private runPowerCycle(): void {
    const soc = this.batteryMonitor.getTotalSOC();
    const solarWatts = this.mppt.getTotalOutputWatts();
    const loadWatts = this.loadShedder.getTotalLoad();
    const inputWatts = solarWatts;

    const newState = socToPowerState(soc, inputWatts, loadWatts);

    if (newState !== this.powerState) {
      const prev = this.powerState;
      this.powerState = newState;
      this.emit('power_state:change', { from: prev, to: newState, soc, solarWatts, loadWatts });
    }

    // Run load shedding
    const { toShed, toRestore } = this.loadShedder.computeShedding(this.powerState, inputWatts || soc * 20);
    if (toShed.length > 0 || toRestore.length > 0) {
      this.loadShedder.applyShedding(toShed, toRestore, this.powerState);
    }

    // Switchover if needed
    const bestSource = this.ups.selectBestSource(solarWatts, soc);
    if (bestSource !== this.ups.getCurrentSource()) {
      this.ups.switchTo(bestSource, 'optimization', soc, loadWatts);
    }

    if (this.powerState === 'shutdown') {
      this.emit('power:shutdown_imminent', { soc, hoursRemaining: 0 });
    }
  }

  private logSnapshot(): void {
    const s = this.getStatus();
    const rf = this.rfHarvester.harvest();
    const snap: PowerSnapshot = {
      timestamp: Date.now(),
      source: s.activeSource,
      solarWatts: s.solarWatts,
      batteryWatts: s.batterySOC * 10,
      loadWatts: s.loadWatts,
      rfHarvestWatts: rf.totalPowerMW / 1000,
      thermalWatts: s.thermalWatts,
      gridWatts: 0,
      netWatts: s.solarWatts - s.loadWatts,
      batterySOC: s.batterySOC,
      batteryVoltage: s.batteryVoltage,
      batteryTemperature: this.batteryMonitor.allBatteries()[0]?.temperature ?? 25,
      powerState: this.powerState,
      loadsActive: s.loadsActive,
      loadsShed: s.loadsShed,
    };
    this.snapshots.push(snap);
    if (this.snapshots.length > 1440) this.snapshots.shift(); // Keep 24h at 1-min intervals
    this.emit('snapshot', snap);
  }

  private registerDefaultOperations(): void {
    const ops: OperationEnergyCost[] = [
      { operationId: 'mesh_tx', wattsTypical: 2.5, durationMs: 100, priority: 'high', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'mesh_rx', wattsTypical: 0.5, durationMs: 1000, priority: 'critical', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'lora_tx', wattsTypical: 0.8, durationMs: 500, priority: 'high', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'crypto_op', wattsTypical: 1.5, durationMs: 50, priority: 'normal', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'consensus', wattsTypical: 3.0, durationMs: 2000, priority: 'high', canDefer: false },
      { operationId: 'dht_lookup', wattsTypical: 1.0, durationMs: 5000, priority: 'normal', canDefer: true },
      { operationId: 'satellite_tx', wattsTypical: 5.0, durationMs: 10000, priority: 'low', canDefer: true },
    ];
    ops.forEach(op => this.budgetManager.registerOperation(op));
  }

  private wireEvents(): void {
    this.batteryMonitor.on('battery:thermal_critical', (data) => {
      this.emit('emergency:thermal', data);
      this.powerState = 'shutdown';
    });
    this.loadShedder.on('load:shed', (data) => this.emit('load:shed', data));
    this.loadShedder.on('load:restore', (data) => this.emit('load:restore', data));
    this.ups.on('switchover', (event) => this.emit('power:switchover', event));
  }
}

export default PowerSovereigntyNode;
/**
 * UBE Phase 11 — meshConsensus.ts
 * Byzantine Fault Tolerant Consensus — Tendermint Protocol
 *
 * Consensus is what separates a mesh of nodes from a sovereign distributed system.
 * Without consensus, any node can lie, fork the state, or replay old decisions.
 * With BFT consensus, up to f < n/3 malicious nodes cannot corrupt the system.
 *
 * Protocol: Tendermint (used by Cosmos, Celestia, Penumbra)
 * Safety: No two honest nodes commit different blocks at the same height (ever)
 * Liveness: Progress guaranteed when >2/3 of validators are honest and online
 *
 * Phases per round:
 *   PROPOSE   → Leader broadcasts a Block proposal
 *   PREVOTE   → Each validator votes on the proposal (or nil)
 *   PRECOMMIT → Each validator precommits if 2/3+ prevotes for same block
 *   COMMIT    → Block committed when 2/3+ precommits for same block
 *
 * View change (round change): automatic timeout escalation if no progress
 *
 * Components:
 *   Block              — Unit of consensus (batch of transactions)
 *   Vote               — Signed message: prevote or precommit
 *   ValidatorSet       — Dynamic set of voting nodes with weights
 *   RoundState         — State machine for one consensus round
 *   ProposerSelector   — Round-robin weighted proposer election
 *   CommitLog          — Append-only log of committed blocks
 *   ConsensusEngine    — Orchestrates the full protocol
 */

import * as crypto from 'crypto';
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { NodeIdentity } from './meshNode';

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSTANTS
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

const CONSENSUS_PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000;
const CONSENSUS_PREVOTE_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;
const CONSENSUS_PRECOMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 2_000;
const CONSENSUS_COMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 1_000;
const CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_DELTA_MS = 500;   // Add per round for adaptive timeouts
const MAX_BLOCK_TRANSACTIONS = 1000;
const MAX_BLOCK_BYTES = 1_048_576;        // 1 MB
const COMMIT_LOG_MAX = 100_000;
const BFT_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR = 2;
const BFT_THRESHOLD_DENOMINATOR = 3;
const ROUND_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS = 60_000;
const VALIDATOR_MAX_MISSED_ROUNDS = 10;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// TYPES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export type VoteType = 'PREVOTE' | 'PRECOMMIT';
export type RoundStep = 'PROPOSE' | 'PREVOTE' | 'PRECOMMIT' | 'COMMIT' | 'NEW_HEIGHT';
export type ConsensusMessageType = 'PROPOSAL' | 'VOTE' | 'ROUND_CHANGE' | 'COMMIT_CERT' | 'SYNC_REQUEST' | 'SYNC_RESPONSE';

export interface Transaction {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  data: Buffer;
  sender: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
  fee: number;
}

export interface BlockHeader {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  timestamp: number;
  prevBlockHash: string;
  txRoot: string;           // Merkle root of transactions
  stateRoot: string;        // Merkle root of state
  validatorsHash: string;   // Hash of current validator set
  proposer: string;         // hex nodeId of proposer
  chainId: string;
}

export interface Block {
  header: BlockHeader;
  transactions: Transaction[];
  hash: string;
  commitCertificate?: CommitCertificate;
}

export interface Vote {
  type: VoteType;
  height: number;
  round: number;
  blockHash: string | null;   // null = nil vote
  validatorId: string;
  validatorPublicKey: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
}

export interface Proposal {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  polRound: number;           // Proof-of-Lock round (-1 if none)
  block: Block;
  proposerId: string;
  timestamp: number;
  signature: string;
}

export interface CommitCertificate {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  blockHash: string;
  signatures: Array<{ validatorId: string; signature: string }>;
}

export interface ValidatorInfo {
  nodeId: string;
  publicKey: string;
  votingPower: number;
  accumulatedPriority: number;   // For proposer selection
  missedRounds: number;
  jailed: boolean;
  joinedAt: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// BLOCK UTILITIES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export function computeBlockHash(header: BlockHeader): string {
  const canonical = JSON.stringify({
    height: header.height, round: header.round, timestamp: header.timestamp,
    prevBlockHash: header.prevBlockHash, txRoot: header.txRoot,
    stateRoot: header.stateRoot, validatorsHash: header.validatorsHash,
    proposer: header.proposer, chainId: header.chainId,
  });
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonical).digest('hex');
}

export function computeTxMerkleRoot(transactions: Transaction[]): string {
  if (transactions.length === 0) return '0'.repeat(64);
  const hashes = transactions.map(tx =>
    crypto.createHash('sha256').update(tx.id + tx.data.toString('hex')).digest('hex')
  );
  return merkleRoot(hashes);
}

function merkleRoot(hashes: string[]): string {
  if (hashes.length === 1) return hashes[0];
  const next: string[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < hashes.length; i += 2) {
    const left = hashes[i];
    const right = hashes[i + 1] ?? hashes[i];
    next.push(crypto.createHash('sha256').update(left + right).digest('hex'));
  }
  return merkleRoot(next);
}

export function buildBlock(
  height: number,
  round: number,
  transactions: Transaction[],
  prevHash: string,
  stateRoot: string,
  validatorsHash: string,
  proposerId: string,
  chainId: string,
): Block {
  const txRoot = computeTxMerkleRoot(transactions);
  const header: BlockHeader = {
    height, round, timestamp: Date.now(),
    prevBlockHash: prevHash, txRoot, stateRoot,
    validatorsHash, proposer: proposerId, chainId,
  };
  const hash = computeBlockHash(header);
  return { header, transactions, hash };
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// VOTE UTILITIES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

function serializeVoteForSigning(vote: Omit<Vote, 'signature'>): Buffer {
  return Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({
    type: vote.type, height: vote.height, round: vote.round,
    blockHash: vote.blockHash, validatorId: vote.validatorId,
    validatorPublicKey: vote.validatorPublicKey, timestamp: vote.timestamp,
  }));
}

export function createVote(
  type: VoteType, height: number, round: number,
  blockHash: string | null, identity: NodeIdentity,
): Vote {
  const partial = {
    type, height, round, blockHash,
    validatorId: identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
    validatorPublicKey: identity.keypair.publicKey.toString('hex'),
    timestamp: Date.now(),
  };
  const sig = identity.sign(serializeVoteForSigning(partial));
  return { ...partial, signature: sig.toString('hex') };
}

export function verifyVote(vote: Vote, publicKey: Buffer): boolean {
  try {
    const data = serializeVoteForSigning(vote);
    const sig = Buffer.from(vote.signature, 'hex');
    const key = crypto.createPublicKey({
      key: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('302a300506032b6570032100', 'hex'), publicKey]),
      format: 'der', type: 'spki',
    });
    return crypto.verify(null, data, key, sig);
  } catch { return false; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// VOTE SET — Collect and tally votes
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface VoteSummary {
  totalPower: number;
  nilPower: number;
  blockPowers: Map<string, number>;  // blockHash -> voting power
  majority: string | null;           // blockHash with 2/3+, or 'nil', or null
  hasTwoThirds: boolean;
  hasNilTwoThirds: boolean;
}

export class VoteSet {
  private votes: Map<string, Vote> = new Map(); // validatorId -> vote
  private readonly height: number;
  private readonly round: number;
  private readonly type: VoteType;
  private readonly validators: ValidatorSet;

  constructor(height: number, round: number, type: VoteType, validators: ValidatorSet) {
    this.height = height;
    this.round = round;
    this.type = type;
    this.validators = validators;
  }

  addVote(vote: Vote): 'added' | 'duplicate' | 'invalid' | 'unknown_validator' {
    if (vote.height !== this.height || vote.round !== this.round || vote.type !== this.type) {
      return 'invalid';
    }
    const validator = this.validators.get(vote.validatorId);
    if (!validator) return 'unknown_validator';
    if (this.votes.has(vote.validatorId)) return 'duplicate';

    const pubKey = Buffer.from(validator.publicKey, 'hex');
    if (!verifyVote(vote, pubKey)) return 'invalid';

    this.votes.set(vote.validatorId, vote);
    return 'added';
  }

  summarize(): VoteSummary {
    const totalPower = this.validators.totalVotingPower();
    const threshold = Math.ceil((totalPower * BFT_THRESHOLD_NUMERATOR) / BFT_THRESHOLD_DENOMINATOR) + 1;

    let nilPower = 0;
    const blockPowers = new Map<string, number>();

    for (const vote of this.votes.values()) {
      const validator = this.validators.get(vote.validatorId);
      const power = validator?.votingPower ?? 0;
      if (vote.blockHash === null) {
        nilPower += power;
      } else {
        blockPowers.set(vote.blockHash, (blockPowers.get(vote.blockHash) ?? 0) + power);
      }
    }

    let majority: string | null = null;
    for (const [hash, power] of blockPowers) {
      if (power >= threshold) { majority = hash; break; }
    }

    return {
      totalPower, nilPower, blockPowers,
      majority,
      hasTwoThirds: majority !== null,
      hasNilTwoThirds: nilPower >= threshold,
    };
  }

  getVote(validatorId: string): Vote | undefined {
    return this.votes.get(validatorId);
  }

  allVotes(): Vote[] {
    return Array.from(this.votes.values());
  }

  count(): number { return this.votes.size; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// VALIDATOR SET
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ValidatorSet {
  private validators: Map<string, ValidatorInfo> = new Map();
  private version: number = 0;

  addValidator(info: ValidatorInfo): void {
    this.validators.set(info.nodeId, info);
    this.version++;
  }

  removeValidator(nodeId: string): void {
    this.validators.delete(nodeId);
    this.version++;
  }

  get(nodeId: string): ValidatorInfo | undefined {
    return this.validators.get(nodeId);
  }

  has(nodeId: string): boolean {
    return this.validators.has(nodeId);
  }

  all(): ValidatorInfo[] {
    return Array.from(this.validators.values()).filter(v => !v.jailed);
  }

  jailValidator(nodeId: string): void {
    const v = this.validators.get(nodeId);
    if (v) { v.jailed = true; this.version++; }
  }

  unjailValidator(nodeId: string): void {
    const v = this.validators.get(nodeId);
    if (v) { v.jailed = false; v.missedRounds = 0; this.version++; }
  }

  totalVotingPower(): number {
    return this.all().reduce((s, v) => s + v.votingPower, 0);
  }

  computeHash(): string {
    const sorted = this.all().sort((a, b) => a.nodeId.localeCompare(b.nodeId));
    return crypto.createHash('sha256')
      .update(JSON.stringify(sorted.map(v => ({ id: v.nodeId, power: v.votingPower }))))
      .digest('hex');
  }

  size(): number { return this.validators.size; }
  getVersion(): number { return this.version; }

  isByzantineTolerant(): boolean {
    const active = this.all();
    const totalPower = active.reduce((s, v) => s + v.votingPower, 0);
    const minHonestPower = Math.ceil((totalPower * 2) / 3) + 1;
    return active.length >= 4; // Need at least 4 for f=1
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// PROPOSER SELECTOR — Weighted round-robin
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class ProposerSelector {
  private priorities: Map<string, number> = new Map();

  // Tendermint proposer selection algorithm
  select(validators: ValidatorSet, height: number, round: number): string | null {
    const active = validators.all();
    if (active.length === 0) return null;

    // Initialize priorities
    for (const v of active) {
      if (!this.priorities.has(v.nodeId)) {
        this.priorities.set(v.nodeId, 0);
      }
    }

    // Increment by voting power
    for (const v of active) {
      const current = this.priorities.get(v.nodeId) ?? 0;
      this.priorities.set(v.nodeId, current + v.votingPower);
    }

    // Proposer is validator with highest priority
    let maxPriority = -Infinity;
    let proposerId = '';
    for (const v of active) {
      const p = this.priorities.get(v.nodeId) ?? 0;
      if (p > maxPriority) { maxPriority = p; proposerId = v.nodeId; }
    }

    // Decrement proposer by total power
    const total = validators.totalVotingPower();
    const propPriority = this.priorities.get(proposerId) ?? 0;
    this.priorities.set(proposerId, propPriority - total);

    return proposerId || null;
  }

  reset(): void { this.priorities.clear(); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// COMMIT LOG
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class CommitLog {
  private commits: Block[] = [];
  private readonly maxEntries: number;
  private heightIndex: Map<number, Block> = new Map();

  constructor(maxEntries: number = COMMIT_LOG_MAX) {
    this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
  }

  append(block: Block): void {
    this.commits.push(block);
    this.heightIndex.set(block.header.height, block);
    if (this.commits.length > this.maxEntries) {
      const evicted = this.commits.shift()!;
      this.heightIndex.delete(evicted.header.height);
    }
  }

  getByHeight(height: number): Block | undefined {
    return this.heightIndex.get(height);
  }

  latest(): Block | null {
    return this.commits[this.commits.length - 1] ?? null;
  }

  latestHeight(): number {
    return this.latest()?.header.height ?? 0;
  }

  latestHash(): string {
    return this.latest()?.hash ?? '0'.repeat(64);
  }

  range(fromHeight: number, toHeight: number): Block[] {
    return this.commits.filter(b => b.header.height >= fromHeight && b.header.height <= toHeight);
  }

  size(): number { return this.commits.length; }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// MEMPOOL
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export class Mempool {
  private txs: Map<string, Transaction> = new Map();
  private readonly maxSize: number;

  constructor(maxSize: number = 10_000) {
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
  }

  add(tx: Transaction): boolean {
    if (this.txs.size >= this.maxSize) return false;
    if (this.txs.has(tx.id)) return false;
    this.txs.set(tx.id, tx);
    return true;
  }

  remove(txIds: string[]): void {
    for (const id of txIds) this.txs.delete(id);
  }

  selectForBlock(maxCount: number = MAX_BLOCK_TRANSACTIONS): Transaction[] {
    return Array.from(this.txs.values())
      .sort((a, b) => b.fee - a.fee || a.timestamp - b.timestamp)
      .slice(0, maxCount);
  }

  has(txId: string): boolean { return this.txs.has(txId); }
  size(): number { return this.txs.size; }
  flush(): void { this.txs.clear(); }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// LOCK — Proof of Lock for Tendermint safety
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface Lock {
  blockHash: string;
  round: number;
  votes: Vote[];
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// ROUND STATE MACHINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface RoundState {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  step: RoundStep;
  proposal: Proposal | null;
  prevotes: VoteSet;
  precommits: VoteSet;
  lockedBlock: string | null;  // blockHash if locked
  lockedRound: number;
  validBlock: string | null;
  validRound: number;
  stepStart: number;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────
// CONSENSUS ENGINE
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────

export interface ConsensusConfig {
  identity: NodeIdentity;
  chainId: string;
  validators: ValidatorSet;
  sendMessage: (targetId: string | null, type: ConsensusMessageType, payload: Buffer) => Promise<void>;
  executeBlock?: (block: Block) => Promise<string>; // Returns new state root
}

export interface ConsensusStats {
  height: number;
  round: number;
  step: RoundStep;
  isProposer: boolean;
  validators: number;
  mempoolSize: number;
  committedBlocks: number;
  roundChanges: number;
  totalVotes: number;
  byzantineFaults: number;
  startedAt: number;
}

export class ConsensusEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly identity: NodeIdentity;
  private readonly chainId: string;
  private readonly validators: ValidatorSet;
  private readonly proposerSelector: ProposerSelector;
  private readonly commitLog: CommitLog;
  public readonly mempool: Mempool;
  private readonly sendMessage: ConsensusConfig['sendMessage'];
  private readonly executeBlock: ConsensusConfig['executeBlock'];

  private rs: RoundState;
  private stepTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;
  private running: boolean = false;

  private stats: ConsensusStats;
  private roundChanges: number = 0;
  private totalVotes: number = 0;
  private byzantineFaults: number = 0;

  constructor(config: ConsensusConfig) {
    super();
    this.identity = config.identity;
    this.chainId = config.chainId;
    this.validators = config.validators;
    this.proposerSelector = new ProposerSelector();
    this.commitLog = new CommitLog();
    this.mempool = new Mempool();
    this.sendMessage = config.sendMessage;
    this.executeBlock = config.executeBlock;

    this.rs = this.newRoundState(1, 0);
    this.stats = {
      height: 1, round: 0, step: 'NEW_HEIGHT', isProposer: false,
      validators: this.validators.size(), mempoolSize: 0,
      committedBlocks: 0, roundChanges: 0, totalVotes: 0,
      byzantineFaults: 0, startedAt: Date.now(),
    };
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.running) return;
    this.running = true;
    this.emit('started', { chainId: this.chainId, height: this.rs.height });
    await this.enterNewHeight(this.rs.height);
  }

  stop(): void {
    this.running = false;
    if (this.stepTimer) clearTimeout(this.stepTimer);
    this.emit('stopped');
  }

  // Called by network layer when a message is received
  async handleMessage(fromId: string, type: ConsensusMessageType, payload: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running) return;
    try {
      const data = JSON.parse(payload.toString('utf8'));
      switch (type) {
        case 'PROPOSAL': await this.handleProposal(data as Proposal); break;
        case 'VOTE': await this.handleVote(fromId, data as Vote); break;
        case 'ROUND_CHANGE': await this.handleRoundChange(data); break;
        case 'SYNC_REQUEST': await this.handleSyncRequest(fromId, data); break;
        case 'COMMIT_CERT': await this.handleCommitCert(data as CommitCertificate); break;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      this.emit('error', { type: 'message_parse', err });
    }
  }

  addTransaction(tx: Transaction): boolean {
    return this.mempool.add(tx);
  }

  getStatus(): ConsensusStats {
    return {
      ...this.stats,
      height: this.rs.height,
      round: this.rs.round,
      step: this.rs.step,
      isProposer: this.isProposer(),
      validators: this.validators.size(),
      mempoolSize: this.mempool.size(),
    };
  }

  getCommitLog(): CommitLog { return this.commitLog; }

  // ── PROTOCOL PHASES ────────────────────────

  private async enterNewHeight(height: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running) return;
    this.rs = this.newRoundState(height, 0);
    this.emit('height:new', { height });
    await this.enterPropose(height, 0);
  }

  private async enterPropose(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running || !this.atStep(height, round, 'PROPOSE')) return;
    this.rs.step = 'PROPOSE';
    this.rs.stepStart = Date.now();
    this.emit('step:propose', { height, round });

    const proposer = this.proposerSelector.select(this.validators, height, round);

    if (proposer === this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex')) {
      await this.broadcastProposal(height, round);
    }

    const timeout = this.proposeTimeout(round);
    this.scheduleTimeout(timeout, () => this.onProposeTimeout(height, round));
  }

  private async broadcastProposal(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    const txs = this.mempool.selectForBlock();
    const stateRoot = await this.executeBlock?.({ header: {} as any, transactions: txs, hash: '' }) ?? '0'.repeat(64);

    const block = buildBlock(
      height, round, txs,
      this.commitLog.latestHash(),
      stateRoot,
      this.validators.computeHash(),
      this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      this.chainId,
    );

    const proposalBody = {
      height, round,
      polRound: this.rs.validRound,
      block,
      proposerId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex'),
      timestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    const sig = this.identity.sign(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(proposalBody)));
    const proposal: Proposal = { ...proposalBody, signature: sig.toString('hex') };

    this.rs.proposal = proposal;
    await this.broadcast('PROPOSAL', Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(proposal)));
    this.emit('proposal:broadcast', { height, round, blockHash: block.hash, txCount: txs.length });
  }

  private async enterPrevote(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running || !this.atStep(height, round, 'PREVOTE')) return;
    this.rs.step = 'PREVOTE';
    this.rs.stepStart = Date.now();
    this.emit('step:prevote', { height, round });

    let voteBlockHash: string | null = null;

    if (this.rs.lockedBlock !== null && this.rs.lockedRound > this.rs.validRound) {
      // Vote for locked block
      voteBlockHash = this.rs.lockedBlock;
    } else if (this.rs.proposal !== null) {
      // Vote for proposal if valid
      if (this.validateBlock(this.rs.proposal.block)) {
        voteBlockHash = this.rs.proposal.block.hash;
      }
    }

    const vote = createVote('PREVOTE', height, round, voteBlockHash, this.identity);
    await this.addAndBroadcastVote(vote);

    const timeout = this.prevoteTimeout(round);
    this.scheduleTimeout(timeout, () => this.onPrevoteTimeout(height, round));
  }

  private async enterPrecommit(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running || !this.atStep(height, round, 'PRECOMMIT')) return;
    this.rs.step = 'PRECOMMIT';
    this.rs.stepStart = Date.now();
    this.emit('step:precommit', { height, round });

    const summary = this.rs.prevotes.summarize();
    let voteBlockHash: string | null = null;

    if (summary.hasTwoThirds && summary.majority) {
      // Lock on the block with 2/3+ prevotes
      this.rs.lockedBlock = summary.majority;
      this.rs.lockedRound = round;
      this.rs.validBlock = summary.majority;
      this.rs.validRound = round;
      voteBlockHash = summary.majority;
    } else if (summary.hasNilTwoThirds) {
      // Unlock
      this.rs.lockedBlock = null;
      this.rs.lockedRound = -1;
    }

    const vote = createVote('PRECOMMIT', height, round, voteBlockHash, this.identity);
    await this.addAndBroadcastVote(vote);

    const timeout = this.precommitTimeout(round);
    this.scheduleTimeout(timeout, () => this.onPrecommitTimeout(height, round));
  }

  private async enterCommit(height: number, round: number, blockHash: string): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running) return;
    this.rs.step = 'COMMIT';
    this.emit('step:commit', { height, round, blockHash });

    const block = this.rs.proposal?.block;
    if (!block || block.hash !== blockHash) {
      // We don't have the block — need to sync
      this.emit('sync:needed', { height, blockHash });
      return;
    }

    // Build commit certificate from precommit votes
    const precommitVotes = this.rs.precommits.allVotes().filter(v => v.blockHash === blockHash);
    const cert: CommitCertificate = {
      height, round, blockHash,
      signatures: precommitVotes.map(v => ({ validatorId: v.validatorId, signature: v.signature })),
    };
    block.commitCertificate = cert;

    // Execute block
    if (this.executeBlock) {
      await this.executeBlock(block);
    }

    // Remove committed transactions from mempool
    this.mempool.remove(block.transactions.map(tx => tx.id));

    // Append to commit log
    this.commitLog.append(block);

    this.emit('block:committed', {
      height, round, blockHash,
      txCount: block.transactions.length,
      proposer: block.header.proposer,
    });

    this.stats.committedBlocks++;

    // Update validator stats
    for (const v of this.validators.all()) {
      const voted = precommitVotes.some(pv => pv.validatorId === v.nodeId);
      if (!voted) {
        v.missedRounds++;
        if (v.missedRounds >= VALIDATOR_MAX_MISSED_ROUNDS) {
          this.validators.jailValidator(v.nodeId);
          this.emit('validator:jailed', { nodeId: v.nodeId, missedRounds: v.missedRounds });
        }
      } else {
        v.missedRounds = 0;
      }
    }

    // Advance height
    setTimeout(() => this.enterNewHeight(height + 1), CONSENSUS_COMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
  }

  private async enterNewRound(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.running) return;
    this.rs.round = round;
    this.rs.step = 'PROPOSE';
    this.rs.proposal = null;
    this.rs.prevotes = new VoteSet(height, round, 'PREVOTE', this.validators);
    this.rs.precommits = new VoteSet(height, round, 'PRECOMMIT', this.validators);
    this.roundChanges++;
    this.stats.roundChanges = this.roundChanges;
    this.emit('round:new', { height, round });

    // Broadcast round change
    await this.broadcast('ROUND_CHANGE', Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ height, round, validatorId: this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex') })));
    await this.enterPropose(height, round);
  }

  // ── VOTE HANDLING ──────────────────────────

  private async handleProposal(proposal: Proposal): Promise<void> {
    if (proposal.height !== this.rs.height || proposal.round !== this.rs.round) return;
    if (this.rs.proposal !== null) return;
    if (!this.validateProposal(proposal)) {
      this.emit('security:invalid_proposal', { proposerId: proposal.proposerId });
      return;
    }
    this.rs.proposal = proposal;
    this.emit('proposal:received', { height: proposal.height, round: proposal.round, blockHash: proposal.block.hash });

    if (this.rs.step === 'PROPOSE') {
      await this.enterPrevote(this.rs.height, this.rs.round);
    }
  }

  private async handleVote(fromId: string, vote: Vote): Promise<void> {
    if (vote.height !== this.rs.height) {
      if (vote.height < this.rs.height) return; // Old vote
      // Future height — may need to sync
      this.emit('sync:needed', { height: vote.height });
      return;
    }

    const voteSet = vote.type === 'PREVOTE' ? this.rs.prevotes : this.rs.precommits;
    const result = voteSet.addVote(vote);

    if (result === 'invalid') {
      this.byzantineFaults++;
      this.stats.byzantineFaults = this.byzantineFaults;
      this.emit('security:invalid_vote', { fromId, vote });
      return;
    }

    if (result !== 'added') return;
    this.totalVotes++;
    this.stats.totalVotes = this.totalVotes;

    const summary = voteSet.summarize();

    if (vote.type === 'PREVOTE') {
      if (summary.hasTwoThirds && this.rs.step === 'PREVOTE') {
        await this.enterPrecommit(this.rs.height, this.rs.round);
      }
      if (summary.hasNilTwoThirds && this.rs.step === 'PREVOTE') {
        // Nil prevote 2/3+: precommit nil
        await this.enterPrecommit(this.rs.height, this.rs.round);
      }
    } else if (vote.type === 'PRECOMMIT') {
      if (summary.hasTwoThirds && summary.majority) {
        await this.enterCommit(this.rs.height, this.rs.round, summary.majority);
      }
      if (summary.hasNilTwoThirds && this.rs.step === 'PRECOMMIT') {
        await this.enterNewRound(this.rs.height, this.rs.round + 1);
      }
    }
  }

  private async handleRoundChange(data: any): Promise<void> {
    const { height, round } = data;
    if (height !== this.rs.height) return;
    if (round > this.rs.round + 1) {
      // Catch up to majority round
      await this.enterNewRound(height, round);
    }
  }

  private async handleCommitCert(cert: CommitCertificate): Promise<void> {
    if (cert.height <= this.commitLog.latestHeight()) return;
    this.emit('sync:commit_cert', cert);
  }

  private async handleSyncRequest(fromId: string, data: any): Promise<void> {
    const { fromHeight, toHeight } = data;
    const blocks = this.commitLog.range(fromHeight, Math.min(toHeight, fromHeight + 100));
    await this.sendMessage(fromId, 'SYNC_RESPONSE', Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ blocks })));
  }

  // ── TIMEOUTS ───────────────────────────────

  private async onProposeTimeout(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.atStep(height, round, 'PROPOSE')) return;
    this.emit('timeout:propose', { height, round });
    await this.enterPrevote(height, round);
  }

  private async onPrevoteTimeout(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.atStep(height, round, 'PREVOTE')) return;
    this.emit('timeout:prevote', { height, round });
    await this.enterPrecommit(height, round);
  }

  private async onPrecommitTimeout(height: number, round: number): Promise<void> {
    if (!this.atStep(height, round, 'PRECOMMIT')) return;
    this.emit('timeout:precommit', { height, round });
    await this.enterNewRound(height, round + 1);
  }

  // ── VALIDATION ─────────────────────────────

  private validateProposal(proposal: Proposal): boolean {
    const proposer = this.proposerSelector.select(this.validators, proposal.height, proposal.round);
    if (proposer !== proposal.proposerId) return false;

    const validator = this.validators.get(proposal.proposerId);
    if (!validator) return false;

    const body = {
      height: proposal.height, round: proposal.round, polRound: proposal.polRound,
      block: proposal.block, proposerId: proposal.proposerId, timestamp: proposal.timestamp,
    };
    const sig = Buffer.from(proposal.signature, 'hex');
    const pubKey = Buffer.from(validator.publicKey, 'hex');
    const data = Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(body));
    try {
      const key = crypto.createPublicKey({
        key: Buffer.concat([Buffer.from('302a300506032b6570032100', 'hex'), pubKey]),
        format: 'der', type: 'spki',
      });
      return crypto.verify(null, data, key, sig);
    } catch { return false; }
  }

  private validateBlock(block: Block): boolean {
    const computedHash = computeBlockHash(block.header);
    if (computedHash !== block.hash) return false;
    const computedTxRoot = computeTxMerkleRoot(block.transactions);
    if (computedTxRoot !== block.header.txRoot) return false;
    if (block.header.chainId !== this.chainId) return false;
    if (block.header.height !== this.rs.height) return false;
    if (block.header.prevBlockHash !== this.commitLog.latestHash()) return false;
    return true;
  }

  // ── HELPERS ────────────────────────────────

  private async addAndBroadcastVote(vote: Vote): Promise<void> {
    const voteSet = vote.type === 'PREVOTE' ? this.rs.prevotes : this.rs.precommits;
    voteSet.addVote(vote);
    await this.broadcast('VOTE', Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(vote)));
    this.emit('vote:cast', { type: vote.type, height: vote.height, round: vote.round, blockHash: vote.blockHash });
  }

  private async broadcast(type: ConsensusMessageType, payload: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    await this.sendMessage(null, type, payload);
  }

  private isProposer(): boolean {
    const proposer = this.proposerSelector.select(this.validators, this.rs.height, this.rs.round);
    return proposer === this.identity.nodeId.toString('hex');
  }

  private atStep(height: number, round: number, step: RoundStep): boolean {
    return this.rs.height === height && this.rs.round === round && this.rs.step === step;
  }

  private scheduleTimeout(ms: number, fn: () => void): void {
    if (this.stepTimer) clearTimeout(this.stepTimer);
    this.stepTimer = setTimeout(fn, Math.min(ms, ROUND_TIMEOUT_MAX_MS));
  }

  private proposeTimeout(round: number): number {
    return CONSENSUS_PROPOSE_TIMEOUT_MS + round * CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_DELTA_MS;
  }

  private prevoteTimeout(round: number): number {
    return CONSENSUS_PREVOTE_TIMEOUT_MS + round * CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_DELTA_MS;
  }

  private precommitTimeout(round: number): number {
    return CONSENSUS_PRECOMMIT_TIMEOUT_MS + round * CONSENSUS_TIMEOUT_DELTA_MS;
  }

  private newRoundState(height: number, round: number): RoundState {
    return {
      height, round, step: 'NEW_HEIGHT', proposal: null,
      prevotes: new VoteSet(height, round, 'PREVOTE', this.validators),
      precommits: new VoteSet(height, round, 'PRECOMMIT', this.validators),
      lockedBlock: null, lockedRound: -1,
      validBlock: null, validRound: -1,
      stepStart: Date.now(),
    };
  }
}

export default ConsensusEngine;
/**
 * UBE Phase 11 — storeForward.ts
 * Delay-Tolerant Networking (DTN) Engine
 *
 * Implements:
 *   - PRoPHET probabilistic routing (Probabilistic Routing Protocol using History
 *     of Encounters and Transitivity)
 *   - Spray-and-Wait epidemic containment with binary splitting
 *   - Custody transfer with cryptographic acknowledgement chains
 *   - Bundle Protocol v7 (RFC 9171) message framing
 *   - Contact graph routing (CGR) for scheduled contact windows
 *   - Store-and-carry-and-forward for fully disconnected mesh segments
 *   - Anti-duplication Bloom filter with TTL decay
 *   - Message prioritization with deadline-aware scheduling
 *   - Fragmentation and reassembly for MTU-limited links
 *   - Epidemic epidemic routing with infection vector tracking
 *
 * Design contract:
 *   - No external dependencies (pure TypeScript + BigInt)
 *   - Survives indefinite network partition — carries messages until path exists
 *   - Cryptographic custody chain — mathematically provable delivery or loss
 *   - Compatible with loraMesh, satelliteFallback, opticalMesh transports
 *
 * @module storeForward
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// TYPES & INTERFACES
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type NodeId = string; // 32-byte hex
export type BundleId = string; // SHA-256 of (source + timestamp + sequence)
export type FragmentId = string;

export interface DTNConfig {
  nodeId: NodeId;
  maxBundleStorageBytes: number;    // e.g. 512 * 1024 * 1024 (512 MB)
  maxBundleTTLSeconds: number;      // e.g. 86400 * 7 (7 days)
  prophetAgeingFactor: number;      // γ ∈ (0,1), typically 0.98
  prophetEncounterInit: number;     // P_init typically 0.75
  prophetTransitivityScaling: number; // β typically 0.25
  sprayWaitCopies: number;          // L copies for Spray-and-Wait, typically 16
  maxFragmentSize: number;          // bytes per fragment, e.g. 200 for LoRa
  custodyTimeoutSeconds: number;    // retry custody if no ACK within this window
  bloomFilterSize: number;          // bits, e.g. 65536
  bloomFilterHashes: number;        // k hash functions, e.g. 7
  contactWindowGracePeriod: number; // seconds before scheduled contact to begin
  priorityQueues: number;           // number of priority levels (e.g. 8)
  maxRetransmissions: number;       // per bundle per contact
}

export const DEFAULT_DTN_CONFIG: DTNConfig = {
  nodeId: '0'.repeat(64),
  maxBundleStorageBytes: 512 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxBundleTTLSeconds: 86400 * 7,
  prophetAgeingFactor: 0.98,
  prophetEncounterInit: 0.75,
  prophetTransitivityScaling: 0.25,
  sprayWaitCopies: 16,
  maxFragmentSize: 200,
  custodyTimeoutSeconds: 300,
  bloomFilterSize: 65536,
  bloomFilterHashes: 7,
  contactWindowGracePeriod: 10,
  priorityQueues: 8,
  maxRetransmissions: 3,
};

// Bundle Protocol v7 (RFC 9171) primary block flags
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_FRAGMENT         = 0x0001;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_ADMIN            = 0x0002;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_NO_FRAGMENT      = 0x0004;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_REQ_CUSTODY      = 0x0008;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_DEST_SINGLETON   = 0x0010;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_ACK_REQUESTED    = 0x0020;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_PRIORITY_BULK    = 0x0000;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_PRIORITY_NORMAL  = 0x0100;
export const BUNDLE_FLAG_PRIORITY_EXPEDITED = 0x0200;

export type BundlePriority = 'bulk' | 'normal' | 'expedited' | 'emergency';
export type RoutingStrategy = 'prophet' | 'spray_wait' | 'epidemic' | 'direct' | 'cgr';
export type CustodyState = 'none' | 'accepted' | 'transferred' | 'released' | 'expired';

export interface BundlePrimaryBlock {
  version: 7;
  bundleId: BundleId;
  flags: number;
  destination: NodeId;
  source: NodeId;
  reportTo: NodeId;
  creationTimestamp: number;  // milliseconds since DTN epoch (2000-01-01T00:00:00Z)
  sequenceNumber: number;
  lifetime: number;           // milliseconds
  fragmentOffset?: number;
  totalADULength?: number;    // Application Data Unit length if fragmented
}

export interface BundlePayloadBlock {
  blockType: 1;
  blockNumber: number;
  flags: number;
  data: Uint8Array;
  checksum: string;           // SHA-256 of data
}

export interface BundleExtensionBlock {
  blockType: number;
  blockNumber: number;
  flags: number;
  data: Uint8Array;
}

export interface Bundle {
  primary: BundlePrimaryBlock;
  payload: BundlePayloadBlock;
  extensions: BundleExtensionBlock[];
  // Routing metadata (not transmitted, local only)
  routingStrategy: RoutingStrategy;
  copiesRemaining: number;        // Spray-and-Wait: copies still to forward
  custodyNode: NodeId | null;     // which node currently holds custody
  custodyState: CustodyState;
  custodyAcceptedAt: number;
  retransmissionCount: number;
  lastAttemptedAt: number;
  priority: BundlePriority;
  receivedAt: number;
  sizeBytes: number;
  deliveredTo: Set<NodeId>;       // nodes we already sent this bundle to
  custodyChain: CustodyRecord[];  // full chain of custody transfers
}

export interface CustodyRecord {
  nodeId: NodeId;
  acceptedAt: number;
  releasedAt: number | null;
  signature: string;              // HMAC-SHA256 of (bundleId + nodeId + acceptedAt)
}

export interface CustodySignal {
  bundleId: BundleId;
  succeeded: boolean;
  reason?: string;
  custodyId: string;              // cryptographic token for this custody transfer
  timestamp: number;
  fromNode: NodeId;
  signature: string;
}

// PRoPHET routing state per neighbor
export interface ProphetDeliveryPredictability {
  neighborId: NodeId;
  deliveryProbability: number;    // P(a,b) ∈ [0,1]
  lastEncounterTime: number;
  encounterCount: number;
  transitivityVector: Map<NodeId, number>; // P(a,c) via b
  lastUpdated: number;
}

// Contact Graph Routing
export interface ContactWindow {
  contactId: string;
  fromNode: NodeId;
  toNode: NodeId;
  startTime: number;              // Unix ms
  endTime: number;
  dataRateBps: number;
  rangeLightSeconds: number;      // propagation delay
  confidence: number;             // 0-1, how certain this contact will occur
}

export interface CGRRoute {
  contactId: string;
  nextHop: NodeId;
  arrivalTime: number;
  confidence: number;
  hops: string[];
}

// Spray-and-Wait state
export interface SprayWaitState {
  bundleId: BundleId;
  totalCopies: number;
  copiesRemaining: number;
  sprayPhaseComplete: boolean;
  waitingFor: Set<NodeId>;        // nodes that received a copy
}

// Epidemic routing infection vector
export interface EpidemicSummaryVector {
  nodeId: NodeId;
  bundleIds: Set<BundleId>;
  timestamp: number;
}

// Fragment reassembly
export interface FragmentBuffer {
  bundleId: BundleId;
  source: NodeId;
  destination: NodeId;
  totalLength: number;
  receivedFragments: Map<number, Uint8Array>; // offset → data
  firstFragmentReceived: number;
  lastFragmentReceived: number;
  isComplete: boolean;
}

// Delivery result
export interface DeliveryResult {
  bundleId: BundleId;
  delivered: boolean;
  deliveredAt: number | null;
  hops: number;
  totalTransitTime: number;
  custodyTransfers: number;
  droppedReason?: string;
}

// Contact event from transport layer
export interface ContactEvent {
  type: 'contact_start' | 'contact_end' | 'data_received' | 'custody_signal';
  neighborId: NodeId;
  timestamp: number;
  dataRateBps?: number;
  bundle?: Bundle;
  custodySignal?: CustodySignal;
  summaryVector?: EpidemicSummaryVector;
}

// Queue statistics
export interface QueueStatistics {
  totalBundles: number;
  totalBytes: number;
  bundlesByPriority: Record<BundlePriority, number>;
  bundlesByStrategy: Record<RoutingStrategy, number>;
  expiredCount: number;
  deliveredCount: number;
  custodyAccepted: number;
