}

// ─── PRNG Helpers (crypto-grade) ──────────────────────────────────────────────

function cryptoShuffle<T>(array: T[]): T[] {
  for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) % (i + 1);
    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
  }
  return array;
}

function cryptoUniform(): number {
  return randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) / 0x100000000;
}

function cryptoChoice<T>(array: T[]): T {
  const idx = randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) % array.length;
  return array[idx];
}

// ─── Sphinx Crypto Layer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Simplified Sphinx packet construction and processing.
 * Sphinx: A Compact and Provably Secure Mix Format (Danezis & Goldberg 2009)
 *
 * Properties:
 *   - Unlinkability: mix node cannot link incoming to outgoing messages
 *   - Bitwise unlinkability: packets change completely at each hop
 *   - Security against active attacks
 *   - Replay detection via seen-MACs tracking
 */
export class SphinxCrypto {
  private readonly seenMACs = new Set<string>();
  private readonly privateKey: Buffer;
  private readonly nodeId: string;

  constructor(privateKey: Buffer, nodeId: string) {
    this.privateKey = privateKey;
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
  }

  /**
   * Create a Sphinx packet for a path through mix nodes.
   * path: ordered array of [nodeId, publicKey] pairs
   * payload: fixed-size message body (padded to SPHINX_BODY_SIZE)
   */
  createPacket(path: Array<{ nodeId: string; publicKey: Buffer }>, payload: Buffer): SphinxPacket {
    if (path.length < MIN_MIX_HOPS) {
      throw new Error(`Sphinx requires at least ${MIN_MIX_HOPS} hops, got ${path.length}`);
    }
    if (path.length > MAX_MIX_HOPS) {
      throw new Error(`Sphinx supports at most ${MAX_MIX_HOPS} hops`);
    }

    // Pad or truncate payload to SPHINX_BODY_SIZE
    const body = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const payloadBytes = Math.min(payload.length, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE - 4);
    payload.copy(body, 4, 0, payloadBytes);
    body.writeUInt32BE(payloadBytes, 0); // Length prefix

    // Generate ephemeral key for each hop using ECDH (simulated with HMAC-based KDF)
    // In production: use X25519 ECDH
    const ephemeralSecrets = path.map((node, i) => {
      const ikm = Buffer.concat([randomBytes(32), node.publicKey, Buffer.from([i])]);
      return createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(ikm).digest();
    });

    // Build layered routing header (innermost first, then wrap outward)
    let header = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    let encryptedBody = body;

    for (let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const node = path[i];
      const secret = ephemeralSecrets[i];
      const isExit = i === path.length - 1;

      // Routing block for this hop
      const routingBlock = Buffer.alloc(64);
      Buffer.from(node.nodeId, 'hex').copy(routingBlock, 0, 0, Math.min(32, 32));
      routingBlock[32] = isExit ? 0x01 : 0x00; // Exit flag
      // Next hop info (zeroed at exit)
      if (!isExit && i < path.length - 1) {
        Buffer.from(path[i + 1].nodeId, 'hex').copy(routingBlock, 33, 0, Math.min(32, 32));
      }

      // Encrypt routing block with node's shared secret
      const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret, Buffer.alloc(16));
      const encRoutingBlock = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(routingBlock), cipher.final()]);

      // Wrap header with this hop's layer
      const newHeader = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
      encRoutingBlock.copy(newHeader, 0, 0, Math.min(64, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE));
      header.copy(newHeader, 64, 0, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE - 64);
      header = newHeader;

      // Encrypt body layer (onion-style, outermost first)
      const bodyCipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret.subarray(0, 32), Buffer.alloc(16));
      encryptedBody = Buffer.concat([bodyCipher.update(encryptedBody), bodyCipher.final()]);
    }

    // Compute outer MAC
    const macKey = createHmac('sha256', ephemeralSecrets[0]).update('mac').digest();
    const mac = createHmac('sha256', macKey)
      .update(header)
      .update(encryptedBody)
      .digest();

    const totalSize = 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32; // version + header + body + mac
    return { version: 1, header, body: encryptedBody, mac, totalSize };
  }

  /**
   * Process an incoming Sphinx packet at this mix node.
   * Peels one layer of encryption, returns next-hop info and transformed packet.
   */
  processPacket(packet: SphinxPacket): {
    routing: DecryptedRoutingInfo;
    nextPacket: SphinxPacket;
    isValid: boolean;
    isReplay: boolean;
  } {
    const macKey = createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update('mac').digest();
    const expectedMac = createHmac('sha256', macKey)
      .update(packet.header)
      .update(packet.body)
      .digest();

    const isValid = expectedMac.equals(packet.mac);
    const macHex = packet.mac.toString('hex');
    const isReplay = this.seenMACs.has(macHex);

    if (!isValid || isReplay) {
      return {
        routing: { nextHopId: '', nextHopAddress: '', delay: 0, isExit: false },
        nextPacket: packet,
        isValid,
        isReplay
      };
    }

    // Record MAC to prevent replay
    this.seenMACs.add(macHex);
    if (this.seenMACs.size > 100000) {
      // Trim oldest entries (approximation)
      const entries = Array.from(this.seenMACs);
      entries.slice(0, 10000).forEach(e => this.seenMACs.delete(e));
    }

    // Derive shared secret for this hop
    const secret = createHmac('sha256', this.privateKey).update(packet.header.subarray(0, 32)).digest();

    // Decrypt routing block
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret, Buffer.alloc(16));
    const routingBlock = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(packet.header.subarray(0, 64)), decipher.final()]);

    const isExit = routingBlock[32] === 0x01;
    const nextHopId = routingBlock.subarray(33, 65).toString('hex');

    // Shift header left (remove processed layer)
    const newHeader = Buffer.alloc(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    packet.header.copy(newHeader, 0, 64, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    randomBytes(64).copy(newHeader, SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE - 64); // Pad with random

    // Decrypt body layer
    const bodyDecipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-ctr', secret.subarray(0, 32), Buffer.alloc(16));
    const decryptedBody = Buffer.concat([bodyDecipher.update(packet.body), bodyDecipher.final()]);

    // Recompute MAC for next hop
    const newMacKey = createHmac('sha256', secret).update('mac').digest();
    const newMac = createHmac('sha256', newMacKey).update(newHeader).update(decryptedBody).digest();

    const nextPacket: SphinxPacket = {
      version: packet.version,
      header: newHeader,
      body: isExit ? decryptedBody : decryptedBody,
      mac: newMac,
      totalSize: packet.totalSize
    };

    const routing: DecryptedRoutingInfo = {
      nextHopId: isExit ? '' : nextHopId,
      nextHopAddress: '',
      delay: Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * 500), // Random delay 0-500ms
      isExit
    };

    return { routing, nextPacket, isValid: true, isReplay: false };
  }

  serialize(packet: SphinxPacket): Buffer {
    const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32);
    buf[0] = packet.version;
    packet.header.copy(buf, 1);
    packet.body.copy(buf, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    packet.mac.copy(buf, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    return buf;
  }

  deserialize(buf: Buffer): SphinxPacket {
    return {
      version: buf[0],
      header: buf.subarray(1, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE),
      body: buf.subarray(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE, 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE),
      mac: buf.subarray(1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE),
      totalSize: buf.length
    };
  }
}

// ─── Mix Pool ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixPool: holds messages before forwarding.
 * Implements anonymity set management and pool normalization.
 */
export class MixPool extends EventEmitter {
  private pool: MixMessage[] = [];
  private readonly maxSize: number;
  private readonly maxBytes: number;
  private currentBytes: number = 0;
  private flushedCount: number = 0;

  constructor(maxSize: number, maxBytes: number) {
    super();
    this.maxSize = maxSize;
    this.maxBytes = maxBytes;
  }

  add(message: MixMessage): boolean {
    const msgSize = message.packet.totalSize;
    if (this.currentBytes + msgSize > this.maxBytes) {
      this.emit('poolFull', { poolSize: this.pool.length });
      return false;
    }
    this.pool.push(message);
    this.currentBytes += msgSize;
    this.emit('added', { id: message.id, poolSize: this.pool.length });
    return true;
  }

  /** Pool Mix: select random subset to forward, retain rest */
  flushPool(retainFraction: number = 0.5): MixMessage[] {
    if (this.pool.length === 0) return [];
    cryptoShuffle(this.pool);
    const sendCount = Math.max(1, Math.floor(this.pool.length * (1 - retainFraction)));
    const toSend = this.pool.splice(0, sendCount);
    for (const m of toSend) this.currentBytes -= m.packet.totalSize;
    this.flushedCount += toSend.length;
    this.emit('flushed', { count: toSend.length, remaining: this.pool.length });
    return cryptoShuffle(toSend);
  }

  /** Threshold Mix: flush all when threshold reached */
  flushThreshold(threshold: number): MixMessage[] | null {
    if (this.pool.length < threshold) return null;
    return this.flushAll();
  }

  /** Flush all messages in random order */
  flushAll(): MixMessage[] {
    const all = cryptoShuffle([...this.pool]);
    this.pool = [];
    this.currentBytes = 0;
    this.flushedCount += all.length;
    this.emit('flushed', { count: all.length, remaining: 0 });
    return all;
  }

  /** Continuous Mix: probabilistically forward each message */
  sampleContinuous(probability: number): MixMessage[] {
    const toSend: MixMessage[] = [];
    const toKeep: MixMessage[] = [];
    for (const msg of cryptoShuffle([...this.pool])) {
      if (cryptoUniform() < probability) {
        toSend.push(msg);
        this.currentBytes -= msg.packet.totalSize;
      } else {
        toKeep.push(msg);
      }
    }
    this.pool = toKeep;
    this.flushedCount += toSend.length;
    return toSend;
  }

  /** Binomial Mix: each message forwarded independently with probability p */
  sampleBinomial(p: number): MixMessage[] {
    return this.sampleContinuous(p);
  }

  /** Normalize pool size with dummy messages */
  padToSize(targetSize: number, createDummy: () => MixMessage): void {
    while (this.pool.length < targetSize) {
      const dummy = createDummy();
      this.pool.push(dummy);
      this.currentBytes += dummy.packet.totalSize;
    }
  }

  size(): number { return this.pool.length; }
  bytes(): number { return this.currentBytes; }
  isFull(): boolean { return this.pool.length >= this.maxSize || this.currentBytes >= this.maxBytes; }
  getFlushedCount(): number { return this.flushedCount; }
  computeAnonymitySet(): number { return this.pool.length; }

  /** Compute entropy of the pool in bits */
  computeEntropy(): number {
    // Shannon entropy based on message arrival times
    if (this.pool.length === 0) return 0;
    return Math.log2(this.pool.length);
  }
}

// ─── Loop Cover Traffic Generator ─────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Generates loop cover traffic — messages that travel the full mix circuit
 * and return to the sender. Prevents intersection attacks by ensuring
 * senders cannot be identified by absence from traffic.
 *
 * From: Loopix (Piotrowska et al. 2017)
 */
export class LoopCoverGenerator {
  private readonly nodeId: string;
  private readonly mixPath: MixNodeInfo[];
  private readonly sphinx: SphinxCrypto;
  private loopsSent: number = 0;
  private loopsReceived: number = 0;
  private readonly sentLoopIds = new Set<string>();

  constructor(nodeId: string, mixPath: MixNodeInfo[], sphinx: SphinxCrypto) {
    this.nodeId = nodeId;
    this.mixPath = mixPath;
    this.sphinx = sphinx;
  }

  generateLoop(): MixMessage {
    const loopId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    this.sentLoopIds.add(loopId);
    this.loopsSent++;

    // Create a loop payload that will route back to this node
    const loopPayload = Buffer.allocUnsafe(64);
    Buffer.from(loopId, 'hex').copy(loopPayload, 0);
    Buffer.from(this.nodeId, 'hex').copy(loopPayload, 32, 0, Math.min(32, 32));

    const activePath = this.mixPath.filter(n => n.isActive).slice(0, MIN_MIX_HOPS);
    if (activePath.length < 1) {
      // Fallback dummy packet
      return this.createDummyMessage();
    }

    const path = activePath.map(n => ({ nodeId: n.nodeId, publicKey: n.publicKey }));
    const packet = this.sphinx.createPacket(path, loopPayload);

    return {
      id: loopId,
      packet,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: path.length,
      isLoop: true,
      isDummy: false
    };
  }

  isLoopReturn(messageId: string): boolean {
    if (this.sentLoopIds.has(messageId)) {
      this.sentLoopIds.delete(messageId);
      this.loopsReceived++;
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  private createDummyMessage(): MixMessage {
    const dummyPayload = randomBytes(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const dummyHeader = randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    const dummyMac = randomBytes(32);
    return {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      packet: { version: 1, header: dummyHeader, body: dummyPayload, mac: dummyMac, totalSize: SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32 + 1 },
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: 0,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: true
    };
  }

  getLoopDeliveryRate(): number {
    if (this.loopsSent === 0) return 0;
    return this.loopsReceived / this.loopsSent;
  }

  getStats() {
    return { loopsSent: this.loopsSent, loopsReceived: this.loopsReceived, pendingLoops: this.sentLoopIds.size };
  }
}

// ─── Mix Node Engine ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixNodeEngine: the primary mix network operator.
 * Can operate as a sender, relay node, or exit node in the mix cascade.
 */
export class MixNodeEngine extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly config: Required<MixConfig>;
  private readonly pool: MixPool;
  private readonly sphinx: SphinxCrypto;
  private readonly knownNodes = new Map<string, MixNodeInfo>();
  private loopGenerator: LoopCoverGenerator | null = null;
  private timedFlushHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private loopHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;
  private isRunning: boolean = false;
  private readonly stats: MixPoolStats;
  private readonly mixDelays: number[] = [];

  constructor(config: Partial<MixConfig>) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      strategy: 'POOL',
      poolSize: DEFAULT_POOL_SIZE,
      threshold: DEFAULT_THRESHOLD,
      timedIntervalMs: DEFAULT_TIMED_INTERVAL_MS,
      continuousForwardProbability: 0.3,
      binomialProbability: 0.5,
      stopAndGoWindowMs: 1000,
      minHops: MIN_MIX_HOPS,
      maxHops: MAX_MIX_HOPS,
      loopCoverProbability: LOOP_COVER_PROBABILITY,
      dummyRatio: DUMMY_RATIO,
      nodeId: randomBytes(32).toString('hex'),
      privateKey: randomBytes(32),
      enableSphinx: true,
      maxPoolSizeBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024,
      ...config
    };
    this.pool = new MixPool(this.config.poolSize * 3, this.config.maxPoolSizeBytes);
    this.sphinx = new SphinxCrypto(this.config.privateKey, this.config.nodeId);
    this.stats = this.initStats();

    this.pool.on('flushed', ({ count }) => {
      this.stats.poolFlushes++;
      this.emit('poolFlushed', { count, nodeId: this.config.nodeId });
    });
  }

  private initStats(): MixPoolStats {
    return {
      strategy: this.config.strategy,
      currentPoolSize: 0,
      totalMessagesReceived: 0,
      totalMessagesForwarded: 0,
      totalDummiesInjected: 0,
      totalLoopMessages: 0,
      averageMixDelay: 0,
      poolFlushes: 0,
      anonymitySetSize: 0,
      entropyBits: 0
    };
  }

  /** Register a known mix node */
  registerNode(node: MixNodeInfo): void {
    this.knownNodes.set(node.nodeId, node);
  }

  /** Start the mix engine */
  start(): void {
    if (this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = true;

    // Initialize loop cover traffic
    const activePaths = Array.from(this.knownNodes.values()).filter(n => n.isActive);
    if (activePaths.length >= MIN_MIX_HOPS) {
      this.loopGenerator = new LoopCoverGenerator(this.config.nodeId, activePaths, this.sphinx);
    }

    // Start strategy-specific processing
    switch (this.config.strategy) {
      case 'TIMED':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.timedFlush(), this.config.timedIntervalMs);
        break;
      case 'CONTINUOUS':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.continuousFlush(), 100);
        break;
      case 'STOP_AND_GO':
        this.startStopAndGo();
        break;
      case 'BINOMIAL':
        this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => this.binomialFlush(), 200);
        break;
    }

    // Loop cover traffic generator
    this.loopHandle = setInterval(() => {
      if (cryptoUniform() < this.config.loopCoverProbability && this.loopGenerator) {
        const loopMsg = this.loopGenerator.generateLoop();
        this.pool.add(loopMsg);
        this.stats.totalLoopMessages++;
      }
    }, 1000);

    this.emit('started', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, strategy: this.config.strategy });
  }

  /** Stop the mix engine */
  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = false;
    if (this.timedFlushHandle) { clearInterval(this.timedFlushHandle); this.timedFlushHandle = null; }
    if (this.loopHandle) { clearInterval(this.loopHandle); this.loopHandle = null; }
    this.emit('stopped', { nodeId: this.config.nodeId, stats: this.getStats() });
  }

  /**
   * Submit a message for mixing.
   * Returns false if pool is full.
   */
  submit(message: MixMessage): boolean {
    this.stats.totalMessagesReceived++;

    // Process Sphinx packet if enabled
    if (this.config.enableSphinx && !message.isDummy) {
      const { routing, nextPacket, isValid, isReplay } = this.sphinx.processPacket(message.packet);
      if (!isValid || isReplay) {
        this.emit('invalidPacket', { id: message.id, isReplay });
        return false;
      }
      message = { ...message, packet: nextPacket, routingInfo: routing };
    }

    // Inject dummy messages at configured ratio
    if (cryptoUniform() < this.config.dummyRatio) {
      this.injectDummy();
    }

    const added = this.pool.add(message);
    this.stats.currentPoolSize = this.pool.size();
    this.stats.anonymitySetSize = this.pool.computeAnonymitySet();
    this.stats.entropyBits = this.pool.computeEntropy();

    // Strategy-specific triggers
    if (added) {
      switch (this.config.strategy) {
        case 'THRESHOLD':
          this.thresholdCheck();
          break;
        case 'POOL':
          this.poolCheck();
          break;
      }
    }

    return added;
  }

  private timedFlush(): void {
    if (this.pool.size() === 0) {
      this.injectDummy();
      return;
    }
    const messages = this.pool.flushAll();
    this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private continuousFlush(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.sampleContinuous(this.config.continuousForwardProbability);
    if (messages.length > 0) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private binomialFlush(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.sampleBinomial(this.config.binomialProbability);
    if (messages.length > 0) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private thresholdCheck(): void {
    const messages = this.pool.flushThreshold(this.config.threshold);
    if (messages) this.forwardMessages(messages);
  }

  private poolCheck(): void {
    if (this.pool.size() >= this.config.poolSize) {
      const messages = this.pool.flushPool(0.5);
      this.forwardMessages(messages);
    }
  }

  private startStopAndGo(): void {
    // Stop-and-Go: synchronized processing windows
    let processing = false;
    this.timedFlushHandle = setInterval(() => {
      if (!processing) {
        processing = true;
        // Receive phase: accept messages (done continuously via submit())
        setTimeout(() => {
          // Go phase: flush and forward
          const messages = this.pool.flushAll();
          this.forwardMessages(messages);
          processing = false;
        }, this.config.stopAndGoWindowMs / 2);
      }
    }, this.config.stopAndGoWindowMs);
  }

  private forwardMessages(messages: MixMessage[]): void {
    // Apply per-message random delay before forwarding
    for (const msg of messages) {
      const delay = Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * 500); // 0-500ms random delay
      this.mixDelays.push(delay);
      if (this.mixDelays.length > 1000) this.mixDelays.shift();

      setTimeout(() => {
        this.stats.totalMessagesForwarded++;
        this.emit('forward', { message: msg, nodeId: this.config.nodeId });
      }, delay);
    }
    this.updateAverageDelay();
  }

  private injectDummy(): void {
    const dummyPayload = randomBytes(SPHINX_BODY_SIZE);
    const dummyHeader = randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE);
    const dummyMac = randomBytes(32);
    const dummy: MixMessage = {
      id: randomBytes(16).toString('hex'),
      packet: { version: 1, header: dummyHeader, body: dummyPayload, mac: dummyMac, totalSize: 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32 },
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: 0,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: true
    };
    this.pool.add(dummy);
    this.stats.totalDummiesInjected++;
  }

  private updateAverageDelay(): void {
    if (this.mixDelays.length === 0) return;
    this.stats.averageMixDelay = this.mixDelays.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / this.mixDelays.length;
  }

  getStats(): Readonly<MixPoolStats> {
    this.stats.currentPoolSize = this.pool.size();
    this.stats.anonymitySetSize = this.pool.computeAnonymitySet();
    this.stats.entropyBits = this.pool.computeEntropy();
    return { ...this.stats };
  }

  getNodeId(): string { return this.config.nodeId; }
  getPublicKey(): Buffer {
    return createHash('sha256').update(this.config.privateKey).digest();
  }
  isActive(): boolean { return this.isRunning; }
  getPoolSize(): number { return this.pool.size(); }
  getKnownNodeCount(): number { return this.knownNodes.size; }
  getLoopStats() { return this.loopGenerator?.getStats(); }
}

// ─── Mix Network Manager ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * MixNetworkManager: orchestrates multiple mix nodes in a cascade.
 * Handles node discovery, path selection, and end-to-end message submission.
 */
export class MixNetworkManager extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly nodes = new Map<string, MixNodeEngine>();
  private readonly nodeRegistry = new Map<string, MixNodeInfo>();
  private readonly localNode: MixNodeEngine;
  private isRunning: boolean = false;

  constructor(localConfig: Partial<MixConfig>) {
    super();
    this.localNode = new MixNodeEngine(localConfig);
    this.nodes.set(this.localNode.getNodeId(), this.localNode);
    this.localNode.on('forward', ({ message }) => this.routeMessage(message));
  }

  /** Add a remote mix node to the known registry */
  addRemoteNode(info: MixNodeInfo): void {
    this.nodeRegistry.set(info.nodeId, info);
    // Propagate to all local nodes
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) {
      node.registerNode(info);
    }
    this.emit('nodeAdded', { nodeId: info.nodeId, tier: info.tier });
  }

  /** Select a random path of `hops` nodes from the registry */
  selectPath(hops: number): MixNodeInfo[] {
    const available = Array.from(this.nodeRegistry.values()).filter(n => n.isActive);
    if (available.length < hops) {
      throw new Error(`Need ${hops} mix nodes but only ${available.length} available`);
    }
    return cryptoShuffle([...available]).slice(0, hops);
  }

  /**
   * Send a message through the mix network.
   * Automatically selects path, wraps in Sphinx, submits to local mix pool.
   */
  async send(payload: Buffer, recipientId: string): Promise<string> {
    const hops = this.localNode['config'].minHops +
      Math.floor(cryptoUniform() * (this.localNode['config'].maxHops - this.localNode['config'].minHops + 1));

    const path = this.nodeRegistry.size >= hops
      ? this.selectPath(hops)
      : [];

    const packet: SphinxPacket = path.length >= MIN_MIX_HOPS
      ? this.localNode['sphinx'].createPacket(
          path.map(n => ({ nodeId: n.nodeId, publicKey: n.publicKey })),
          payload
        )
      : {
          version: 1,
          header: randomBytes(SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE),
          body: Buffer.concat([payload.subarray(0, Math.min(payload.length, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE)), randomBytes(Math.max(0, SPHINX_BODY_SIZE - payload.length))]),
          mac: randomBytes(32),
          totalSize: 1 + SPHINX_HEADER_SIZE + SPHINX_BODY_SIZE + 32
        };

    const messageId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const message: MixMessage = {
      id: messageId,
      packet,
      receivedAt: Date.now(),
      hopCount: path.length,
      isLoop: false,
      isDummy: false,
      routingInfo: path.length > 0 ? {
        nextHopId: path[0].nodeId,
        nextHopAddress: path[0].address,
        delay: 0,
        isExit: false,
        recipientId
      } : undefined
    };

    const accepted = this.localNode.submit(message);
    if (!accepted) throw new Error('Mix pool full — message rejected');

    this.emit('messageSent', { messageId, hops: path.length, recipientId });
    return messageId;
  }

  private routeMessage(message: MixMessage): void {
    if (!message.routingInfo) return;
    const { isExit, recipientId } = message.routingInfo;
    if (isExit) {
      this.emit('messageDelivered', { messageId: message.id, recipientId });
    } else {
      // Forward to next node (in real deployment: send over network)
      this.emit('messageForwarded', { messageId: message.id, nextHop: message.routingInfo.nextHopId });
    }
  }

  start(): void {
    if (this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = true;
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) node.start();
    this.emit('networkStarted', { localNodeId: this.localNode.getNodeId() });
  }

  stop(): void {
    if (!this.isRunning) return;
    this.isRunning = false;
    for (const node of this.nodes.values()) node.stop();
    this.emit('networkStopped');
  }

  getLocalNodeId(): string { return this.localNode.getNodeId(); }
  getLocalPublicKey(): Buffer { return this.localNode.getPublicKey(); }
  getKnownNodeCount(): number { return this.nodeRegistry.size; }
  getStats() { return this.localNode.getStats(); }

  /** Check network health — anonymity set size, entropy, node availability */
  healthCheck(): {
    healthy: boolean;
    anonymitySetSize: number;
    activeNodes: number;
    entropyBits: number;
    issues: string[];
  } {
    const stats = this.localNode.getStats();
    const activeNodes = Array.from(this.nodeRegistry.values()).filter(n => n.isActive).length;
    const issues: string[] = [];

    if (activeNodes < MIN_MIX_HOPS) issues.push(`Insufficient mix nodes: ${activeNodes} < ${MIN_MIX_HOPS}`);
    if (stats.anonymitySetSize < 5) issues.push(`Anonymity set too small: ${stats.anonymitySetSize}`);
    if (stats.entropyBits < 2) issues.push(`Pool entropy too low: ${stats.entropyBits.toFixed(2)} bits`);

    return {
      healthy: issues.length === 0,
      anonymitySetSize: stats.anonymitySetSize,
      activeNodes,
      entropyBits: stats.entropyBits,
      issues
    };
  }
}

// ─── Exports ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export {
  MixNetworkManager as default,
  MixNodeEngine,
  MixPool,
  SphinxCrypto,
  LoopCoverGenerator
};
/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * onionRouter.ts — Onion Routing Engine
 *
 * Full onion routing implementation with layered encryption, forward secrecy,
 * and relay management. Each relay knows only its predecessor and successor —
 * never the full path, origin, or destination.
 *
 * Architecture:
 *   - Circuit-based routing with 3-8 hop paths
 *   - X25519 ECDH key exchange per relay (simulated with HMAC-KDF)
 *   - AES-256-CTR stream cipher per layer
 *   - HMAC-SHA256 per-layer authentication
 *   - Forward secrecy via ephemeral keys
 *   - Circuit teardown with key material erasure
 *   - Hidden services (rendezvous point protocol)
 *   - Guard node selection for Sybil resistance
 *   - Bandwidth-weighted relay selection
 *
 * Threat model:
 *   - Global passive adversary observing all links
 *   - Compromised relays (up to n-1 of n)
 *   - Active timing attacks
 *   - Predecessor attacks
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/onionRouter
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes, createHmac, createHash, createCipheriv, createDecipheriv, diffieHellman } from 'crypto';

// ─── Constants ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export const MIN_HOPS = 3;
export const MAX_HOPS = 8;
export const DEFAULT_HOPS = 3;
export const CELL_SIZE = 512;
export const CIRCUIT_ID_SIZE = 4;
export const RELAY_HEADER_SIZE = 11;
export const CRYPTO_CELL_SIZE = CELL_SIZE - CIRCUIT_ID_SIZE;
export const KEY_MATERIAL_SIZE = 72; // 20 Kf + 20 Kb + 16 Kc + 16 Kd
export const CIRCUIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 600000; // 10 minutes
export const MAX_CIRCUITS = 1000;
export const GUARD_NODE_COUNT = 3;

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type CellCommand =
  | 'PADDING'
  | 'CREATE'
  | 'CREATED'
  | 'RELAY'
  | 'DESTROY'
  | 'CREATE2'
  | 'CREATED2'
  | 'VERSIONS'
  | 'NETINFO'
  | 'RELAY_EARLY';

export type RelayCommand =
  | 'BEGIN'
  | 'DATA'
  | 'END'
  | 'CONNECTED'
  | 'SENDME'
  | 'EXTEND'
  | 'EXTENDED'
  | 'TRUNCATE'
  | 'TRUNCATED'
  | 'DROP'
  | 'RESOLVE'
  | 'RESOLVED'
  | 'BEGIN_DIR'
  | 'ESTABLISH_INTRO'
  | 'ESTABLISH_RENDEZVOUS'
  | 'INTRODUCE1'
  | 'INTRODUCE2'
  | 'RENDEZVOUS1'
  | 'RENDEZVOUS2';

export type CircuitStatus =
  | 'BUILDING'
  | 'OPEN'
  | 'FAILED'
  | 'CLOSED'
  | 'GUARD_WAIT';

export interface RelayDescriptor {
  readonly nodeId: string;
  readonly fingerprint: Buffer;
  readonly publicKey: Buffer;
  readonly address: string;
  readonly port: number;
  readonly bandwidthKbps: number;
  readonly isGuard: boolean;
  readonly isExit: boolean;
  readonly isMiddle: boolean;
  readonly countryCode: string;
  readonly onionKey: Buffer;
  readonly identityKey: Buffer;
  isReachable: boolean;
  lastTestedMs: number;
  uptimeSeconds: number;
  flags: Set<string>;
}

export interface CircuitHop {
  readonly relay: RelayDescriptor;
  readonly hopIndex: number;
  readonly circuitId: number;
  forwardKey: Buffer;     // Kf — key for sending data
  backwardKey: Buffer;    // Kb — key for receiving data
  forwardIV: Buffer;      // Initialization vector for forward
  backwardIV: Buffer;     // Initialization vector for backward
  forwardDigest: Buffer;  // Running digest for forward cells
  backwardDigest: Buffer; // Running digest for backward cells
  isEstablished: boolean;
}

export interface Circuit {
  readonly circuitId: string;
  readonly hops: CircuitHop[];
  status: CircuitStatus;
  readonly createdAt: number;
  lastActivityAt: number;
  readonly purpose: CircuitPurpose;
  bytesSent: number;
  bytesReceived: number;
  cellsSent: number;
  cellsReceived: number;
}

export type CircuitPurpose =
  | 'GENERAL'
  | 'CONTROLLER'
  | 'HIDDEN_SERVICE_INTRO'
  | 'HIDDEN_SERVICE_REND'
  | 'TESTING'
  | 'DIRECTORY';

export interface OnionCell {
  readonly circuitId: number;
  readonly command: CellCommand;
  readonly payload: Buffer; // Fixed CELL_SIZE - 5 bytes
  readonly totalSize: number;
}

export interface RelayCell {
  readonly command: RelayCommand;
  readonly streamId: number;
  readonly digest: Buffer;  // 4 bytes
  readonly length: number;
  readonly data: Buffer;
}

export interface OnionRouterConfig {
  minHops: number;
  maxHops: number;
  defaultHops: number;
  cellSize: number;
  circuitTimeoutMs: number;
  maxCircuits: number;
  guardNodeCount: number;
  preferSameCountry: boolean;
  excludeCountries: string[];
  bandwidthWeightedSelection: boolean;
  enableHiddenServices: boolean;
}

export interface CircuitBuildResult {
  circuitId: string;
  hops: number;
  buildTimeMs: number;
  relayPath: string[];
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

// ─── Key Derivation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * KDF for onion router key material.
 * Derives forward key, backward key, forward IV, backward IV from shared secret.
 * In production: replace with X25519 ECDH + HKDF-SHA256.
 */
export class OnionKDF {
  /**
   * Derive key material from shared secret using HKDF-like construction.
   * Returns: Kf(32) || Kb(32) || IVf(16) || IVb(16) = 96 bytes
   */
  static derive(sharedSecret: Buffer, circuitId: number, hopIndex: number): {
    forwardKey: Buffer;
    backwardKey: Buffer;
    forwardIV: Buffer;
    backwardIV: Buffer;
    forwardDigest: Buffer;
    backwardDigest: Buffer;
  } {
    const salt = Buffer.allocUnsafe(8);
    salt.writeUInt32BE(circuitId, 0);
    salt.writeUInt32BE(hopIndex, 4);

    // HKDF-style expansion
    const prk = createHmac('sha256', salt).update(sharedSecret).digest();

    const expand = (info: string, len: number): Buffer => {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      let T = Buffer.alloc(0);
      let i = 1;
      while (chunks.reduce((s, b) => s + b.length, 0) < len) {
        T = createHmac('sha256', prk).update(T).update(info).update(Buffer.from([i++])).digest();
        chunks.push(T);
      }
      return Buffer.concat(chunks).subarray(0, len);
    };

    return {
      forwardKey: expand('Kf', 32),
      backwardKey: expand('Kb', 32),
      forwardIV: expand('IVf', 16),
      backwardIV: expand('IVb', 16),
      forwardDigest: expand('Df', 20),
      backwardDigest: expand('Db', 20)
    };
  }
}

// ─── Cell Builder ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Builds, parses, and validates onion cells.
 * All cells are exactly CELL_SIZE bytes — no variable-length cells.
 */
export class CellBuilder {
  private static commandBytes: Record<CellCommand, number> = {
    PADDING: 0, CREATE: 1, CREATED: 2, RELAY: 3, DESTROY: 4,
    CREATE2: 5, CREATED2: 6, VERSIONS: 7, NETINFO: 8, RELAY_EARLY: 9
  };

  private static commandFromByte: Record<number, CellCommand> = {
    0: 'PADDING', 1: 'CREATE', 2: 'CREATED', 3: 'RELAY', 4: 'DESTROY',
    5: 'CREATE2', 6: 'CREATED2', 7: 'VERSIONS', 8: 'NETINFO', 9: 'RELAY_EARLY'
  };

  static build(circuitId: number, command: CellCommand, payload: Buffer): Buffer {
    const cell = Buffer.alloc(CELL_SIZE);
    cell.writeUInt32BE(circuitId, 0);
    cell[4] = CellBuilder.commandBytes[command] ?? 0;
    const payloadBytes = payload.subarray(0, CELL_SIZE - 5);
    payloadBytes.copy(cell, 5);
    // Pad remainder with random bytes
    if (CELL_SIZE - 5 - payloadBytes.length > 0) {
      randomBytes(CELL_SIZE - 5 - payloadBytes.length).copy(cell, 5 + payloadBytes.length);
    }
    return cell;
  }

  static parse(cell: Buffer): OnionCell {
    if (cell.length < CELL_SIZE) throw new Error(`Cell too short: ${cell.length} < ${CELL_SIZE}`);
    const circuitId = cell.readUInt32BE(0);
    const commandByte = cell[4];
    const command = CellBuilder.commandFromByte[commandByte] ?? 'PADDING';
    const payload = cell.subarray(5);
    return { circuitId, command, payload, totalSize: CELL_SIZE };
  }

  static buildRelayCell(
    circuitId: number,
    relayCmd: RelayCommand,
    streamId: number,
    data: Buffer,
    digest: Buffer
  ): Buffer {
    const relayCmds: Record<RelayCommand, number> = {
      BEGIN: 1, DATA: 2, END: 3, CONNECTED: 4, SENDME: 5, EXTEND: 6, EXTENDED: 7,
      TRUNCATE: 8, TRUNCATED: 9, DROP: 10, RESOLVE: 11, RESOLVED: 12, BEGIN_DIR: 13,
      ESTABLISH_INTRO: 14, ESTABLISH_RENDEZVOUS: 15, INTRODUCE1: 16, INTRODUCE2: 17,
      RENDEZVOUS1: 18, RENDEZVOUS2: 19
    };
    const payload = Buffer.alloc(CELL_SIZE - 5);
    payload[0] = relayCmds[relayCmd] ?? 0;
    payload.writeUInt16BE(0, 1); // Recognized
    payload.writeUInt16BE(streamId, 3);
    digest.copy(payload, 5, 0, 4);
    payload.writeUInt16BE(data.length, 9);
    data.copy(payload, 11, 0, Math.min(data.length, payload.length - 11));
    return CellBuilder.build(circuitId, 'RELAY', payload);
  }

  static buildPaddingCell(circuitId: number): Buffer {
    return CellBuilder.build(circuitId, 'PADDING', randomBytes(CELL_SIZE - 5));
  }
}

// ─── Onion Encryptor ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Applies and strips onion encryption layers.
 * Each hop adds/removes one AES-256-CTR layer.
 */
export class OnionEncryptor {
  /**
   * Encrypt payload through all hops (outermost last).
   * Data is encrypted innermost-first so outermost relay peels first.
   */
  static encryptForward(payload: Buffer, hops: CircuitHop[]): Buffer {
    let encrypted = Buffer.from(payload);
    for (let i = hops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      encrypted = OnionEncryptor.encryptLayer(encrypted, hops[i].forwardKey, hops[i].forwardIV);
    }
    return encrypted;
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt one layer (at relay — peels outermost layer).
   */
  static decryptLayer(payload: Buffer, hop: CircuitHop): Buffer {
    return OnionEncryptor.encryptLayer(payload, hop.forwardKey, hop.forwardIV);
  }

  /**
   * Encrypt one layer for sending backward (relay → client).
   */
  static encryptBackward(payload: Buffer, hops: CircuitHop[]): Buffer {
    let encrypted = Buffer.from(payload);
    for (const hop of hops) {
      encrypted = OnionEncryptor.encryptLayer(encrypted, hop.backwardKey, hop.backwardIV);
    }
    return encrypted;
  }

  /**
   * Decrypt backward layers (client removes all layers to get plaintext).
   */
  static decryptBackward(payload: Buffer, hops: CircuitHop[]): Buffer {
    let decrypted = Buffer.from(payload);
    for (let i = hops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      decrypted = OnionEncryptor.decryptLayerBack(decrypted, hops[i]);
    }
    return decrypted;
  }

  private static encryptLayer(data: Buffer, key: Buffer, iv: Buffer): Buffer {
    const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-ctr', key, iv);
    return Buffer.concat([cipher.update(data), cipher.final()]);
  }

  private static decryptLayerBack(data: Buffer, hop: CircuitHop): Buffer {
    const decipher = createDecipheriv('aes-256-ctr', hop.backwardKey, hop.backwardIV);
    return Buffer.concat([decipher.update(data), decipher.final()]);
  }

  /** Update running digest for relay integrity checking */
  static updateDigest(digest: Buffer, data: Buffer): Buffer {
    return createHmac('sha256', digest).update(data).digest().subarray(0, 20);
  }

  /** Verify relay cell digest */
  static verifyDigest(cell: Buffer, expectedDigest: Buffer): boolean {
    const computed = createHash('sha1').update(cell).digest().subarray(0, 4);
    return computed.equals(expectedDigest.subarray(0, 4));
  }
}

// ─── Relay Selector ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Selects relay nodes for circuit construction.
 * Implements bandwidth-weighted random selection with geographic diversity.
 */
export class RelaySelector {
  private readonly relays: RelayDescriptor[];
  private guardNodes: RelayDescriptor[] = [];

  constructor(relays: RelayDescriptor[]) {
    this.relays = relays;
    this.selectGuardNodes();
  }

  private selectGuardNodes(): void {
    // Select high-bandwidth, stable relays as guards
    const candidates = this.relays
      .filter(r => r.isGuard && r.isReachable && r.uptimeSeconds > 86400)
      .sort((a, b) => b.bandwidthKbps - a.bandwidthKbps);
    this.guardNodes = candidates.slice(0, GUARD_NODE_COUNT);
  }

  /**
   * Select a circuit path with geographic diversity.
   * Guard → Middle(s) → Exit — no two hops in same /16 subnet or country.
   */
  selectPath(hops: number, excludeCountries: string[] = []): RelayDescriptor[] {
    if (this.relays.length < hops) {
      throw new Error(`Need ${hops} relays, only ${this.relays.length} available`);
    }

    const path: RelayDescriptor[] = [];
    const usedCountries = new Set<string>();
    const usedIds = new Set<string>();

    // Select guard (first hop)
    const guard = this.selectGuard(excludeCountries);
    if (!guard) throw new Error('No suitable guard node available');
    path.push(guard);
    usedCountries.add(guard.countryCode);
    usedIds.add(guard.nodeId);

    // Select middle hops
    for (let i = 1; i < hops - 1; i++) {
      const middle = this.selectMiddle(usedIds, usedCountries, excludeCountries);
      if (!middle) throw new Error(`Cannot find middle relay for hop ${i}`);
      path.push(middle);
      usedCountries.add(middle.countryCode);
      usedIds.add(middle.nodeId);
    }

    // Select exit
    const exit = this.selectExit(usedIds, usedCountries, excludeCountries);
    if (!exit) throw new Error('No suitable exit relay available');
    path.push(exit);

    return path;
  }

  private selectGuard(excludeCountries: string[]): RelayDescriptor | null {
    const suitable = this.guardNodes.filter(
      r => r.isReachable && !excludeCountries.includes(r.countryCode)
    );
    if (suitable.length === 0) {
      return this.bandwidthWeightedSelect(
        this.relays.filter(r => r.isReachable && !r.isExit && !excludeCountries.includes(r.countryCode))
      );
    }
    return this.bandwidthWeightedSelect(suitable);
  }

  private selectMiddle(
    usedIds: Set<string>,
    usedCountries: Set<string>,
    excludeCountries: string[]
  ): RelayDescriptor | null {
    const candidates = this.relays.filter(r =>
      r.isReachable && r.isMiddle &&
      !usedIds.has(r.nodeId) &&
      !usedCountries.has(r.countryCode) &&
      !excludeCountries.includes(r.countryCode)
    );
    return this.bandwidthWeightedSelect(candidates);
  }

  private selectExit(
    usedIds: Set<string>,
    usedCountries: Set<string>,
    excludeCountries: string[]
  ): RelayDescriptor | null {
    const candidates = this.relays.filter(r =>
      r.isReachable && r.isExit &&
      !usedIds.has(r.nodeId) &&
      !usedCountries.has(r.countryCode) &&
      !excludeCountries.includes(r.countryCode)
    );
    return this.bandwidthWeightedSelect(candidates);
  }

  private bandwidthWeightedSelect(candidates: RelayDescriptor[]): RelayDescriptor | null {
    if (candidates.length === 0) return null;
    const totalBw = candidates.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.bandwidthKbps, 0);
    if (totalBw === 0) return candidates[Math.floor(Math.random() * candidates.length)];

    let target = (randomBytes(4).readUInt32BE(0) / 0x100000000) * totalBw;
    for (const relay of candidates) {
      target -= relay.bandwidthKbps;
      if (target <= 0) return relay;
    }
    return candidates[candidates.length - 1];
  }

  addRelay(relay: RelayDescriptor): void {
    this.relays.push(relay);
    if (relay.isGuard) this.selectGuardNodes();
  }

  markReachable(nodeId: string, reachable: boolean): void {
    const relay = this.relays.find(r => r.nodeId === nodeId);
    if (relay) relay.isReachable = reachable;
  }

  getActiveRelayCount(): number { return this.relays.filter(r => r.isReachable).length; }
  getGuardNodes(): RelayDescriptor[] { return [...this.guardNodes]; }
}

// ─── Circuit Manager ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Manages the lifecycle of onion routing circuits.
 * Build, extend, use, teardown, and rotate circuits.
 */
export class CircuitManager extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly circuits = new Map<string, Circuit>();
  private readonly relaySelector: RelaySelector;
  private readonly config: Required<OnionRouterConfig>;
  private readonly cleanupHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;
  private circuitCounter: number = 0;

  constructor(relays: RelayDescriptor[], config: Partial<OnionRouterConfig>) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      minHops: MIN_HOPS,
      maxHops: MAX_HOPS,
      defaultHops: DEFAULT_HOPS,
      cellSize: CELL_SIZE,
      circuitTimeoutMs: CIRCUIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
      maxCircuits: MAX_CIRCUITS,
      guardNodeCount: GUARD_NODE_COUNT,
      preferSameCountry: false,
      excludeCountries: [],
      bandwidthWeightedSelection: true,
      enableHiddenServices: false,
      ...config
    };
    this.relaySelector = new RelaySelector(relays);
    this.cleanupHandle = setInterval(() => this.evictExpiredCircuits(), 30000);
  }

  /**
   * Build a new circuit through the onion network.
   * Performs key exchange with each hop in sequence.
   */
  async buildCircuit(
    hops: number = this.config.defaultHops,
    purpose: CircuitPurpose = 'GENERAL'
  ): Promise<CircuitBuildResult> {
    const startMs = Date.now();

    if (this.circuits.size >= this.config.maxCircuits) {
      return { circuitId: '', hops, buildTimeMs: 0, relayPath: [], success: false, error: 'Max circuits reached' };
    }

    let path: RelayDescriptor[];
    try {
      path = this.relaySelector.selectPath(hops, this.config.excludeCountries);
    } catch (err) {
      return { circuitId: '', hops, buildTimeMs: 0, relayPath: [], success: false, error: String(err) };
    }

    const circuitId = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
    const circuitHops: CircuitHop[] = [];

    // Perform key exchange with each hop
    for (let i = 0; i < path.length; i++) {
      const relay = path[i];
      const circuitIdNum = ++this.circuitCounter;

      // Simulate ECDH: In production, use X25519 from @noble/curves
      const clientEphemeral = randomBytes(32);
      const sharedSecret = createHmac('sha256', clientEphemeral)
        .update(relay.publicKey)
        .update(Buffer.from([i]))
        .digest();

      const keys = OnionKDF.derive(sharedSecret, circuitIdNum, i);

      const hop: CircuitHop = {
        relay,
        hopIndex: i,
        circuitId: circuitIdNum,
        ...keys,
        isEstablished: true
      };
      circuitHops.push(hop);
    }

    const circuit: Circuit = {
      circuitId,
      hops: circuitHops,
      status: 'OPEN',
      createdAt: Date.now(),
      lastActivityAt: Date.now(),
      purpose,
      bytesSent: 0,
      bytesReceived: 0,
      cellsSent: 0,
      cellsReceived: 0
    };

    this.circuits.set(circuitId, circuit);
    const buildTimeMs = Date.now() - startMs;

    this.emit('circuitBuilt', { circuitId, hops: path.length, buildTimeMs, purpose });
    return {
      circuitId,
      hops: path.length,
      buildTimeMs,
      relayPath: path.map(r => r.nodeId),
      success: true
    };
  }

  /**
   * Send data through a circuit.
   * Data is wrapped in onion layers and sent as relay cells.
   */
  sendData(circuitId: string, data: Buffer, streamId: number = 1): Buffer[] {
    const circuit = this.circuits.get(circuitId);
    if (!circuit || circuit.status !== 'OPEN') throw new Error(`Circuit ${circuitId} not open`);

    circuit.lastActivityAt = Date.now();
    const cells: Buffer[] = [];

    // Chunk data into cell-sized pieces
    let offset = 0;
    while (offset < data.length) {
      const chunk = data.subarray(offset, offset + this.config.cellSize - RELAY_HEADER_SIZE - 5);
      offset += chunk.length;

      // Build relay cell payload
      const digest = createHash('sha1').update(chunk).digest().subarray(0, 4);
      const relayPayload = Buffer.alloc(CELL_SIZE - 5);
      relayPayload[0] = 2; // DATA command
      relayPayload.writeUInt16BE(0, 1); // Recognized
      relayPayload.writeUInt16BE(streamId, 3);
      digest.copy(relayPayload, 5);
      relayPayload.writeUInt16BE(chunk.length, 9);
      chunk.copy(relayPayload, 11);

      // Apply onion encryption
      const encrypted = OnionEncryptor.encryptForward(relayPayload, circuit.hops);

      // Build final cell with circuit ID
      const cell = Buffer.alloc(CELL_SIZE);
      const primaryCircId = circuit.hops[0].circuitId;
      cell.writeUInt32BE(primaryCircId, 0);
      cell[4] = 3; // RELAY
      encrypted.copy(cell, 5);

      cells.push(cell);
      circuit.bytesSent += chunk.length;
      circuit.cellsSent++;
    }

    this.emit('dataSent', { circuitId, bytes: data.length, cells: cells.length });
    return cells;
  }

  /**
   * Receive and decrypt data from a circuit.
   */
  receiveCell(circuitId: string, rawCell: Buffer): Buffer | null {
    const circuit = this.circuits.get(circuitId);
    if (!circuit) return null;

    const cell = CellBuilder.parse(rawCell);
    if (cell.command !== 'RELAY') return null;

    circuit.lastActivityAt = Date.now();

    // Strip onion layers
    const decrypted = OnionEncryptor.decryptBackward(cell.payload, circuit.hops);

    // Parse relay cell
    const relayCmd = decrypted[0];
    const dataLen = decrypted.readUInt16BE(9);
    const data = decrypted.subarray(11, 11 + dataLen);

    circuit.bytesReceived += data.length;
    circuit.cellsReceived++;

    this.emit('dataReceived', { circuitId, bytes: data.length });
    return data;
  }

  /** Close and destroy a circuit, zeroing all key material */
  closeCircuit(circuitId: string): void {
    const circuit = this.circuits.get(circuitId);
    if (!circuit) return;

    circuit.status = 'CLOSED';

    // Zero key material
    for (const hop of circuit.hops) {
      hop.forwardKey.fill(0);
      hop.backwardKey.fill(0);
      hop.forwardIV.fill(0);
      hop.backwardIV.fill(0);
      hop.forwardDigest.fill(0);
      hop.backwardDigest.fill(0);
    }

    this.circuits.delete(circuitId);
    this.emit('circuitClosed', { circuitId });
  }

  /** Send PADDING cells to prevent traffic analysis via silence periods */
  sendPadding(circuitId: string): Buffer {
    const circuit = this.circuits.get(circuitId);
    if (!circuit) return Buffer.alloc(CELL_SIZE);
    return CellBuilder.buildPaddingCell(circuit.hops[0].circuitId);
  }

  private evictExpiredCircuits(): void {
    const now = Date.now();
    for (const [id, circuit] of this.circuits.entries()) {
      if (now - circuit.lastActivityAt > this.config.circuitTimeoutMs) {
        this.closeCircuit(id);
        this.emit('circuitExpired', { circuitId: id });
      }
    }
  }

  getCircuit(circuitId: string): Readonly<Circuit> | null {
    return this.circuits.get(circuitId) ?? null;
  }

  getActiveCircuitCount(): number {
    return Array.from(this.circuits.values()).filter(c => c.status === 'OPEN').length;
  }

  getAllCircuitStats() {
    return Array.from(this.circuits.values()).map(c => ({
      circuitId: c.circuitId,
      status: c.status,
      hops: c.hops.length,
      bytesSent: c.bytesSent,
      bytesReceived: c.bytesReceived,
      ageMs: Date.now() - c.createdAt,
      purpose: c.purpose
    }));
  }

  destroy(): void {
    clearInterval(this.cleanupHandle);
    for (const id of this.circuits.keys()) this.closeCircuit(id);
  }
}

// ─── Hidden Service Protocol ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * Hidden service rendezvous point protocol.
 * Allows services to be reached without revealing their IP address.
 *
 * Protocol:
 *   1. Service builds circuits to 3+ introduction points
 *   2. Service publishes introduction point descriptors
 *   3. Client builds circuit to rendezvous point
 *   4. Client sends INTRODUCE1 to introduction point
 *   5. Introduction point sends INTRODUCE2 to service
 *   6. Service builds circuit to rendezvous point
 *   7. Service sends RENDEZVOUS1 — connection established
 */
export class HiddenServiceProtocol extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly serviceId: string;
  private readonly circuitManager: CircuitManager;
  private introductionCircuits: string[] = [];
  private rendezvousCircuits = new Map<string, string>();
  private isPublished: boolean = false;
  private readonly servicePrivateKey: Buffer;
  private readonly servicePublicKey: Buffer;

  constructor(circuitManager: CircuitManager) {
    super();
    this.circuitManager = circuitManager;
    this.servicePrivateKey = randomBytes(32);
    this.servicePublicKey = createHash('sha256').update(this.servicePrivateKey).digest();
    this.serviceId = this.deriveServiceId();
  }

  private deriveServiceId(): string {
    // .onion address is SHA3-256 of public key (simplified)
    return createHash('sha256').update(this.servicePublicKey).digest().subarray(0, 16).toString('hex');
  }

  /** Establish introduction points */
  async establishIntroPoints(count: number = 3): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      try {
        const result = await this.circuitManager.buildCircuit(
          DEFAULT_HOPS,
          'HIDDEN_SERVICE_INTRO'
        );
        if (result.success) {
          this.introductionCircuits.push(result.circuitId);
        }
      } catch (err) {
        this.emit('introError', { error: err, attempt: i });
      }
    }
    this.isPublished = this.introductionCircuits.length >= 1;
    this.emit('introPointsEstablished', { count: this.introductionCircuits.length });
  }

  /** Handle incoming introduction request (from client via intro point) */
  async handleIntroduce2(rendezvousPointId: string, rendezvousCookie: Buffer): Promise<void> {
    // Build circuit to rendezvous point
    const result = await this.circuitManager.buildCircuit(
      DEFAULT_HOPS,
      'HIDDEN_SERVICE_REND'
    );
    if (!result.success) {
      this.emit('rendezvousError', { rendezvousPointId });
      return;
    }

    this.rendezvousCircuits.set(rendezvousPointId, result.circuitId);

    // Send RENDEZVOUS1 to complete connection
    const handshakeData = Buffer.concat([rendezvousCookie, randomBytes(20)]);
    this.circuitManager.sendData(result.circuitId, handshakeData);

    this.emit('rendezvousEstablished', {
      rendezvousPointId,
      circuitId: result.circuitId,
      serviceId: this.serviceId
    });
  }

  /** Send data through an established rendezvous circuit */
  sendToClient(rendezvousPointId: string, data: Buffer): Buffer[] {
    const circuitId = this.rendezvousCircuits.get(rendezvousPointId);
    if (!circuitId) throw new Error(`No rendezvous circuit for ${rendezvousPointId}`);
    return this.circuitManager.sendData(circuitId, data);
  }

  getServiceId(): string { return this.serviceId; }
  getOnionAddress(): string { return `${this.serviceId}.onion`; }
  getPublicKey(): Buffer { return this.servicePublicKey; }
  isServicePublished(): boolean { return this.isPublished; }
  getIntroCircuitCount(): number { return this.introductionCircuits.length; }

  destroy(): void {
    for (const circuitId of this.introductionCircuits) {
      this.circuitManager.closeCircuit(circuitId);
    }
    for (const circuitId of this.rendezvousCircuits.values()) {
      this.circuitManager.closeCircuit(circuitId);
    }
  }
}

// ─── Onion Router — Master Interface ─────────────────────────────────────────

/**
 * OnionRouter: top-level interface for all onion routing operations.
 */
export class OnionRouter extends EventEmitter {
  private readonly circuitManager: CircuitManager;
  private readonly hiddenService: HiddenServiceProtocol | null = null;
  private readonly config: Required<OnionRouterConfig>;
  private prebuiltCircuits: string[] = [];
  private readonly paddingHandle: ReturnType<typeof setInterval>;

  constructor(relays: RelayDescriptor[], config: Partial<OnionRouterConfig> = {}) {
    super();
    this.config = {
      minHops: MIN_HOPS, maxHops: MAX_HOPS, defaultHops: DEFAULT_HOPS,
      cellSize: CELL_SIZE, circuitTimeoutMs: CIRCUIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
      maxCircuits: MAX_CIRCUITS, guardNodeCount: GUARD_NODE_COUNT,
      preferSameCountry: false, excludeCountries: [],
      bandwidthWeightedSelection: true, enableHiddenServices: false,
      ...config
    };
    this.circuitManager = new CircuitManager(relays, this.config);
    if (this.config.enableHiddenServices) {
      this.hiddenService = new HiddenServiceProtocol(this.circuitManager);
    }
    this.circuitManager.on('circuitBuilt', d => this.emit('circuitBuilt', d));
    this.circuitManager.on('circuitClosed', d => this.emit('circuitClosed', d));

    // Continuous padding to prevent silence detection
    this.paddingHandle = setInterval(() => this.sendAllPadding(), 1000);
  }

  /** Pre-build circuits for low-latency sending */
  async prebuilt(count: number = 3): Promise<void> {
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const result = await this.circuitManager.buildCircuit(this.config.defaultHops, 'GENERAL');
      if (result.success) this.prebuiltCircuits.push(result.circuitId);
    }
    this.emit('prebuilt', { count: this.prebuiltCircuits.length });
  }

  /** Send data, using a prebuilt circuit if available */
  async send(data: Buffer): Promise<{ circuitId: string; cells: Buffer[] }> {
    let circuitId = this.prebuiltCircuits.shift();
    if (!circuitId) {
      const result = await this.circuitManager.buildCircuit(this.config.defaultHops, 'GENERAL');
      if (!result.success) throw new Error('Failed to build circuit');
      circuitId = result.circuitId;
    }
    // Replenish prebuilt pool in background
    this.circuitManager.buildCircuit(this.config.defaultHops, 'GENERAL')
      .then(r => { if (r.success) this.prebuiltCircuits.push(r.circuitId); })
      .catch(() => {});

    const cells = this.circuitManager.sendData(circuitId, data);
    return { circuitId, cells };
  }

  receive(circuitId: string, rawCell: Buffer): Buffer | null {
    return this.circuitManager.receiveCell(circuitId, rawCell);
  }

  closeCircuit(circuitId: string): void {
    this.circuitManager.closeCircuit(circuitId);
    this.prebuiltCircuits = this.prebuiltCircuits.filter(id => id !== circuitId);
  }

  private sendAllPadding(): void {
    for (const [id] of this.circuitManager.getAllCircuitStats().filter(c => c.status === 'OPEN').entries()) {
      // Send padding to maintain minimum traffic
      // In real deployment: transmit these cells on the network
    }
  }

  async setupHiddenService(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (!this.hiddenService) return null;
    await this.hiddenService.establishIntroPoints(3);
    return this.hiddenService.getOnionAddress();
  }

  getStats() {
    return {
      activeCircuits: this.circuitManager.getActiveCircuitCount(),
      prebuiltCircuits: this.prebuiltCircuits.length,
      circuits: this.circuitManager.getAllCircuitStats(),
      hiddenService: this.hiddenService ? {
        address: this.hiddenService.getOnionAddress(),
        published: this.hiddenService.isServicePublished()
      } : null
    };
  }

  healthCheck(): { healthy: boolean; issues: string[] } {
    const issues: string[] = [];
    const relayCount = this.circuitManager['relaySelector'].getActiveRelayCount();
    if (relayCount < this.config.minHops) issues.push(`Insufficient relays: ${relayCount}`);
    if (this.circuitManager.getActiveCircuitCount() === 0 && this.prebuiltCircuits.length === 0) {
      issues.push('No active or prebuilt circuits');
    }
    return { healthy: issues.length === 0, issues };
  }

  destroy(): void {
    clearInterval(this.paddingHandle);
    this.circuitManager.destroy();
    this.hiddenService?.destroy();
  }
}

  HiddenServiceProtocol

/**
 * UBE Phase 2 — Metadata Sovereignty
 * coverTraffic.ts — Cover Traffic Generation Engine
 *
 * Generates synthetic traffic that is statistically indistinguishable from
 * real traffic, preventing adversaries from identifying idle periods, usage
 * patterns, or active sessions through traffic absence analysis.
 *
 * Models implemented:
 *   1. Loopix Model       — Poisson process cover traffic (Piotrowska 2017)
 *   2. Statistical Mimicry — Matches real traffic's statistical fingerprint
 *   3. Renewal Process    — Erlang-k distributed inter-event times
 *   4. Markov Chain Model — State-machine traffic generation
 *   5. Trace Replay       — Replay recorded traffic profiles
 *   6. Adversarial Model  — Generated to defeat specific classifier attacks
 *
 * Defeats:
 *   - Website fingerprinting via traffic volume
 *   - Intersection attacks (who is active when?)
 *   - Long-term behavioral profiling
 *   - On/off traffic pattern detection
 *   - Time-zone inference from activity patterns
 *
 * @module metadata-sovereignty/coverTraffic
 * @version 1.0.0
 */

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
import { CryptoRandom } from './jitter';

export const MIN_COVER_PACKET_SIZE = 512;
export const MAX_COVER_PACKET_SIZE = 1400;

export const MARKOV_STATE_COUNT = 8;
export const ERLANG_K_STAGES = 3;

// ─── Types ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  | 'LOOPIX'
  | 'STATISTICAL_MIMICRY'
  | 'RENEWAL_PROCESS'

  | 'ADVERSARIAL'
  | 'CONSTANT_RATE'
  | 'ADAPTIVE_BLEND';
